articleTitle: Methodology for Accounting for the Influence of Dust Cover on the Performance of a Photovoltaic System for Matlab Simulink
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The model of maneuvering unit based on generating and accumulating capacities, which are elements of an autonomous mobile settlement, is proposed. The generating, accumulating and maneuvering capacities are analyzed. Two types of neural networks for an integrated power system forecasting and analysis system are analyzed. The best option is selected. The variants of accumulator units placement according to the theory of reliability of electric power systems are analyzed. The role of this agile unit, its fate and functions in the power system are established

articleTitle: Management of Innovation Activity in the Conditions of Industry 4.0
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The ability to generate, implement and use innovation affects the pace of development of all sectors of the economy. The purpose of the article is to identify the features of innovation management in the context of Industry 4.0, as well as to substantiate the model of innovation management in the conditions of Industry 4.0. Research methods: content analysis (literature review), expert survey and graphic method. Results of the research: identifying the opinion of experts, who have experience in promoting incentives, implementation and evaluation of innovation, through a survey allowed to form the model of innovation management in the conditions of Industry 4.0. The proposed approach allows substantiating the main goals of innovation management in Industry 4.0

articleTitle: Research of the Stress State While Obtaining Tapered Flares on the Connecting Elements of Electrical Wires
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: It is shown that high requirements of mechanical strength, corrosion resistance and minimal losses at magnetization reversal during the passage of alternating current are imposed on the connecting elements of electric overhead lines. Sometimes the diameters of the wire ends are increased for the convenience of inserting them into connectors. In pressure treatment this process is known as dispensing. During dispensing the wall thickness of the edge sections decreases and, under certain conditions, destruction of the workpiece may occur in the form of a crack at the end. Besides, overestimated dispensing coefficients result in a loss of stability of the non-deformable part. To avoid these undesirable phenomena and reduce the production cost of tubular connecting elements, the authors of the paper analyze the factors that cause rejects during plastic deformation. It is shown that the yield point of the material and the shell thickness are the workflow main parameters that have a prevailing effect on the loss of stability of the non-deformable part of the workpiece. By changing them, it is possible to achieve the manufacture of high-quality connectors for electrical wires.

articleTitle: The Challenge of Developing Quality Profile of the Electrical and Energy Engineering Higher Education in Ukraine in the Context of World Experience
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper analyzes the difficulties of determining the quality profile of higher education in the field of study "Electrical Engineering" in Ukraine. It is substantiated that the reasons consist in the lack of a system of mechanisms capable of assessing the educational quality in a wide range of its perfection and in various fields of training, especially, the national ranking in general (institutional) and sectoral (subject) versions. The possibility to use the leading world university rankings such as ARWU, THE World University Rankins and QS World University Rankins with this purpose is considered. The implementation in Ukraine within the framework of the Bologna process of European experience of providing the quality of higher education based on its standardization and accreditation is analyzed. Relevant recommendations concerning the creation of the profile of the quality of higher education in general and in the field of study "Electrical Engineering" in particular are formulated.

articleTitle: Model of Formation of Ecological Competence of Future Engineers-Electromechanics
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The article reveals the concept of environmental competence of future electromechanical engineers as a manifestation of the acquisition of environmental knowledge and skills to apply them in their professional and domestic activities. The components of ecological competence of future electromechanical engineers are characterized as: value-motivational, cognitive, and operational activity. It was found that the allocation of three interdependent and interdependent components allows to quickly manage the process of formation of environmental knowledge, providing mobility and direction, as well as the prerequisites for creating a system of professional activities, consisting of special and environmental activities. The model of formation of ecological competence of future engineers-electromechanics is offered and results of its experimental approbation during the distance educational process are presented.

articleTitle: Guaranteed and Reliable Excitation of Asynchronous Generator Coupled to Shaft of Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: A method for determining the minimum allowable speed of the asynchronous generator shaft is proposed and the results of graphical and analytical solution for an asynchronous machine are given. The analytical dependence of the minimum allowable speed of the induction shaft as a function of the parameters of the drive motor of internal combustion, capacitive excitation and load, which must be provided by selecting the gear ratio of the mechanical coupling device. The general criterion for selecting the size of the transmission rollers is presented in the form of a quality functional, which takes into account the range of variation of the crankshaft speed of the primary engine, the range of variation of the diameter of the transmission roller and the range of fuel consumption at the corresponding crankshaft speed.

articleTitle: Innovative Safety of the Ukrainian Electrical Industry: Benchmarking Indicators for Provision
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: the article is devoted to the study of the main threats to the innovative security of knowledge-intensive branches of the Ukrainian industry; the study of the prospects for the intensive development of the national economy; determination of the most significant determinants of ensuring the innovative safety of the electrical industry in Ukraine. It was installed that the formation of innovation security`s system of the electrotechnical industry is influenced by several determinants, which can be grouped in such a way: intellectual and personnel, technical and technological, financial, investment and conjectural.

articleTitle: The Correction of the Operation Modes for Frequency-Controlled Induction Motor with Scalar Control under Stator Windings Damage Appearance
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: wide application in the industry of the regulated electric drives systems allows one to create effective energy saving technology which implementation allows one not only to save electric energy, but also to increase equipments' service life. Nowadays in the mass systems of the industrial regulated electric drive, in the systems of heat and water supply which work, generally, in continuous static modes with a constant loading, systems of the frequency-controlled electric drive with scalar control takes a dominant place. However, the proper operation of the adjustable electric drive depends on the reliable operation of the induction motor, the power unit of the energy converter and the control system, and in the process of operation, each of these components may fail. The paper presents a method for fault-tolerant control of an induction motor which works as a part of a frequency-controlled electric drive system with scalar control for the case of damage in the power circuit of the electric motor stator. The proposed method is based on the reduction of the task signal in the damaged phase in proportion to the asymmetry rate of the active resistances of the motor phases. The study results for the presented system confirm the possibility of improving the dynamic and energy characteristics of the regulated electric drive. The proposed control strategy is easy to implement and does not require the installation of new sensors or changes in the power circuit of the classic system of frequency-controlled electric drive.

articleTitle: Academic Performance’ Dynamics of Generation Z Representatives (Electrical Engineering Students and Other Specialties) During the Transition to E-learning in Covid-19 Crisis
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The purpose of the research is to study the dynamics of academic achievement of the Ukrainian generation Z during the transition to e-learning due to the COVID-19 pandemic. The relevance of the chosen topic is due to the fact that the study of the dynamics of students’ academic performance during the transition to a distance format in a pandemic COVID-19 provides an opportunity to explore the benefits of this form, as well as identify problem areas. To achieve this goal, the following tasks were set and solved: the students’ academic performance was monitored at the end of the fall and spring semesters of 2019-2020 (i.e. before the beginning of distance learning and after the end of the academic year in the distance format) to identify the dynamics of success and clarify its correlation with such indicators as gender, year of study (graduation or non-graduation), speciality profile. A survey of students was conducted to study the attitude to e-learning and identify the most popular platforms and tools for distance learning. Based on the results of monitoring and survey, the specifics of Generation Z in terms of academic performance in e-learning is analysed and recommendations are developed. The study confirmed the hypothesis that representatives of Generation Z show higher academic performance in e-learning compared to the traditional form. The results of the survey showed that most of the respondents have a positive attitude to e-learning, although they consider it as a temporary option in a crisis. The main advantages of e-earning students consider the ability to focus on specialized subjects and flexible time planning for learning; the main disadvantages are the lack of real communication and instant feedback. The most popular platforms (means) of elearning were Moodle and Zoom.

articleTitle: The Research of a Two-Mass System with a PID Controller, Considering the Control Object Identification
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The development of an effective positioning drive control system is quite complex due to the need to ensure the movement of the working body with a given accuracy and for a certain time. To improve the quality of transients, a simplified mathematical description of the control object has been developed by its identification, which allows to reduce the calculated power during modeling and increase the accuracy of finding the coefficients of the PID controller. Based on the results of object identification, a mathematical model was developed, and its adequacy was experimentally proved. With the help of a mathematical model, the settings of the PID controller that provide the required parameters of the transient process were found, and the test was performed on a laboratory stand.

articleTitle: Laboratory Stand for Research of Energy Characteristics of Electric Vehicle Drives
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: This work is devoted to the study of the energy characteristics of a vehicle electric drive. A stand has been developed makes it possible to measure the electrical power consumed by a variable-frequency drive, while varying the rotational speed of the motor shaft and the torque generated by it. On the ground of the data obtained using the stand, a family of curves was constructed that describe the dependence of the efficiency on the torque at a fixed rotating frequency. The analysis of the obtained dependencies showed the presence of maxima, which provide a basis for finding the minimum energy consumption during acceleration by varying the gearbox ratio.

articleTitle: Formation of Resource Potential Management Mechanism at Industrial Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The article is devoted to the analysis of the economic mechanism of resource formation at industrial enterprise potential on the basis of establishment the relationship between consumer and cost principles of estimation of results of industrial activity. The essence of concept and structure of resource potential of the enterprise, as well as factors of its efficiency are disclosed. It has been proved that the resource potential of an industrial enterprise is the sum of technical and technological capital, mediated by the correlation dependence of human, innovative, investment resources with a functional task according to the criterion of cost savings in production cycles. A methodological approach has been proposed for its evaluation on the basis of the ratio between the number of saved resources in consumption and the value of the total costs of production. Its essence is the definition of the functional relationship between the consumption of resources in the process of consumption and the effective indicator of products in terms of the totality of consumer properties, that is, a number of production parameters that are formed in the process of consuming products in subsequent production cycles. This ensures the implementation of management decisions for the efficient use of resource potential. Directions have been suggested to increase the efficiency of use of the enterprise resource potential using a systems approach.

articleTitle: A Review of Topologies of Quick Charging Stations for Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper presents various schematics of power electronic converters of so-called quick charging stations for electric vehicles. The quick or fast charging stations are those who implement controlled rectification and have enough capacity to charge electric vehicle within 10-15 minutes, which requires around 50 kW power for average modern electric vehicle. The principal diagrams of converters for the most common charging stations are given, as well as the equations for their description. Oscillogram are shown to illustrate the operation of each type of charging station. Analysis of performances and limitations is carried out.

articleTitle: Influence of Supply Voltage on the Accuracy of Two-Speed Elevator Positioning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: In the modern world, residents of large cities cannot imagine their life without elevators. This vertical movement vehicle is used in all types of urban infrastructure buildings, such as residential buildings, office and shopping and entertainment centers, hospitals, enterprises, etc. The design and control system of elevators are constantly developing and improving, as well as increasing safety requirements and the quality of the lift mechanisms. Elevator installations with control from frequency converters, which entail significant material costs, are gaining more and more popularity. Achieving a constant supply voltage is one of the most important tasks, since the less fluctuations and voltage drops in the system, the longer the service life of the equipment. In addition, the stability of the control systems and actuators depends on this. Considering all of the above, this work is aimed at improving the positioning accuracy of both outdated and modern control systems, taking into account the current norms and requirements for operation, subject to saving financial costs.

articleTitle: Forecasting the Efficiency of the Control System of the Technological Object on the Basis of Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Efficient functioning is the first and foremost problem of the control system of technological objects while evaluating its performance. The evaluation criteria can be as follows: the degree of relation between the control action and the control signal; the integrated index of the system dynamics; the statistical measure of the system quality. The article suggests an approach towards forecasting the efficiency of the control system based on neural networks. The efficiency forecasting of the control system on the basis of neural networks with a various number of hidden neurons has been performed. The best result has been demonstrated by the 4-7-2 MLP (multilayer perceptron) network which possesses four input, seven hidden and two output neurons respectively. The MLP has secured 99.19 % performance in the training sample and 98.97 % in the testing sample. The results obtained secure the rational use of the chosen neural network architecture for the purpose of forecasting the efficiency of the control system.

articleTitle: Management of Competitive Advantages of Higher Education Institutions
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The intensification of competition in domestic and foreign markets is forcing higher education institutions to look for new sources and ways to gain competitive advantage, which determine the position of universities in a competitive environment. Therefore, it is necessary to consider the field of higher education as a highly competitive market in which higher education institutions compete with each other in the same way as enterprises. In the Article competitive advantage is the study program. The synthesis of elements of Business Model Canvas and Criteria for the Study Programme Quality Evaluation defined by National Agency for Higher Education Quality Assurance (Ukraine) is offered for forming the concept of the study program. Therefore, taking into account all the elements (or partially) of the Business Model Canvas, it is possible to create a quality product – the study program, which in the future the HEI’s must promote on the market. The necessity of implementing the concept of SP for the field of 14 "Electrical Engineering" is proved.

Author Keywords: National Agency for Higher Education Quality Assurance (NAQA)

articleTitle: Open-End Winding Dual Three-Phase BLDC Motor Drive System with Integrated Hybrid Battery-Supercapacitor Energy Storage for Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The modular approach to configuration of a power-traction system of an electric vehicle (EV) is applied in a complex way. In particular, the power circuit combines such well-known efficient solutions as a modular hybrid on-board battery/supercapacitor electric energy storage system, a synchronous machine with permanent magnets and two three-phase armature winding sets, open ends of the armature winding sets with dual side power supply. Three voltage inverters were used to combine and control these machine’s modules forming a symmetrical T-shaped configuration of the EV power-traction system. Another feature of the proposed configuration is the control system of electric drive based on a principle of the brushless DC motor (BLDCM), which greatly simplifies the control of energy flows in the system. To effectively combining the applied solutions, an appropriate control system algorithm has been developed, the operability of which is confirmed by the results of computer simulation.

articleTitle: Management of the Logistics Component of the Grain HarvestingProcess with Consideration of the Choice of Automobile Transport Technology Based on the Energetic Criterion
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Purpose of the paper is using the energetic criterion for improving the efficiency of road transport of crop of cereals. The methodological basis of the study is a systematic approach to the study of issues of development and improving the efficiency of the transport process in agricultural production, by modeling and optimizing the required number of cars. The study was carried out by economic and mathematical modeling of the composition of the harvesting and transport complex. Methods of linear mathematical programming were used. It has been established that the optimization of the parameters of the transport process of harvesting and transporting crop of cereals it is an actual task. For the continuous delivery of the mowed cereals to the place of storage without interrupting technological operations, the total productivity of vehicles (cars or tractor carts) must correspond to the actual productivity of harvesting aggregates (forage harvesters). At the same time, the number of transport units for specific harvesting conditions should be optimal according to the criterion of minimum energy costs for transporting crop of cereals. To develop the optimization model, the following assumptions were made: the harvesting and transport group of the storage complex is a combination of the same type of forage harvesters and vehicles of the same carrying capacity; the cereals e is loaded into a vehicle moving next to the combine, and then delivered to the place of storage, at that time the combine is waiting for the vehicle to return; the duration of the working cycles of the combine and the vehicle are taken as constant and multiple values, that is, a deterministic model is used. The number of vehicles at which the specific energy costs during harvesting and transportation of green mass to the storage will be minimal will be optimal for the harvesting and transport complex under consideration. Optimization mathematical model has been developed for the transport service process of forage harvesters that takes into account the conditions of this process. The criterion for the effectiveness of the choice option is the specific energy costs when harvesting and transporting crop of cereals (the objective function of the mathematical model), provided that they are minimized. Factors that determine these costs are identified and calculated dependencies are developed for their determination. The comprehensive method of optimizing the technology for harvesting and transporting crop of cereals from farms growing crops with the participation of road transport was further developed.

articleTitle: Comparison of the Active Parts of Single-Phase Transformers with Twisted and Laminated Magnetic Circuits
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: A numerical comparative analysis of indicators of the technical level of planar rod, armored and spatial armored electromagnetic systems with twisted and laminated magnetic circuits was carried out. To determine the advantages and justify the choice of the design of a single-phase transformer, a universal method of objective functions for optimizing electromagnetic systems with dimensionless indicators of the technical level and relative controlled variables was used. When determining the objective functions based on the condition of electromagnetic equivalence, the materials used, the amplitudes of the magnetic field in the rods and current density of the windings, the average values of yokes, as well as the design and cooling methods of electromagnetic static devices were taken to be the same. It was determined that twisted electromagnetic systems are the best according to the criterion of minimum mass of active materials in comparison with laminated ones.

articleTitle: Creative Workspaces of a Modern University in Terms of Student-centered Teaching
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The ways of creating resource workspaces of a modern university in the aspect of student-centered teaching are researched, since they contribute to the realization of the intellectual and creative potential of students. The positive experience of Ukrainian universities is analyzed with the aim of implementation of successful samples into the practice of Kremenchuk Mykhailo Ostrohradskyi National University. Special attention is paid to coworking centers as locations for effective teamwork and comfortable rest. Their potential for the formation of the necessary competencies, social work skills and civic activities is studied. The possibility of creating a TechnoMuseum on the basis of the university is also being considered. This will allow not only to optimize the training of students of technical specialties, but also to create an attractive place for excursions, primarily for students of schools and vocational schools. An additional positive effect of the emergence of a coworking center and a TechnoMuseum is the ability to attract financial resources from outside.

Author Keywords: intellectual and creative potential of students

articleTitle: Resource Management under Waveguide Production Competitiveness Support
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper considers important problem of resource management under waveguide production and its competitiveness. New technique of production management on the basis of effective use of resources has been proposed to find production reserves and determine efficiency of innovation decisions.

articleTitle: Approximation of ECG Signals by Labview Software
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: In this work, the algorithm is improved and a virtual device is created for automatic determination of parameters of approximating asymmetric Gaussian curves in the Labview software environment for analysis of electrocardiographic signals. As a result, the confidence of recognition when approximating waves in the presence of deviations and distortions of the shape of the wave is increased.

articleTitle: Voltage and Power Regulation of an Induction Generator-Based Hydroelectric Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper considers an induction generator-based hydro power generation system (HPGS) with a regulated hydro turbine (HT). The HPGS can operate as a grid connected system and as an emergency generator when power grid fails. The system consists of a HT, an induction generator (IG), no load capacitors (NLC), contactor-switched capacitors (CSC), a dump load (DL), a step up power transformer and a distribution transformer connected to a transfer switch (TS). A procedure for synchronization the IG with the grid is proposed and block diagram of a synchronization controller (SC) is developed. The SC control strategy is based on the edge detection method. NLC and CSC power ratings are determined using performance characteristics of the IG and the IG voltage reference limits in standalone mode (SM) of the system. The proposed control algorithm for hysteresis controllers (HYC) provides dead band reactive power (RP) regulation of the HPGS at the point of common coupling (PCC) in grid-connected mode (GM) and hysteresis voltage control in SM. Electric frequency control of the HPGS during the IG synchronization with the grid is carried out using a regulated DL. The HT wicket gate (WG) angle reference in SM of the HPGS was proportionally adjusted to local load demand. Simulation of the HPGS during its synchronization with the grid and in SM has been performed and discussed.

articleTitle: Simulation and Laboratory Model of Induction Heating in COMSOL Multiphysics
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: the phenomenon of induction heating is a very energy efficient way of heating bodies. However, it depends on various factors, making the problem highly nonlinear. Mathematical analysis of this problem is in most cases very complex and is reduced to simple cases. Further knowledge of induction heating systems is gained in production environments, but these trial and error procedures are long and expensive. Another approach to reduce the above disadvantages is numerical models of the induction heating problem. This paper deals with a simulation model of the induction heating problem. A simulation model of the induction heating system in the COMSOL Multiphysics program is created. Equivalent inductance and equivalent resistance of the induction coil and workpiece connection during the heating and temperature change process are obtained for different parameters of the alternating current flowing through the induction coil. The model includes nonlinear electromagnetic and thermal properties of the workpiece material. The simulation model provides basic information about the processes taking place in the heated material. To verify the simulation model, experimental measurements are performed using the designed and implemented power converter.

articleTitle: Determination of the Mechanical and Electrical Properties of Bimetallic Thermoelectric Contacts
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The quality and the reliability of bimetallic thermal contacts largely depends on the mechanical characteristics of the layers that make up the bimetal, as well as on the method of their manufacturing. The article presents the results of experimental determination of the tensile strength and flow limit of a bimetallic metal compound, which is obtained by explosive welding, as also the results of the measurements of the tested composition electrical resistance. After welding, the layers of bimetal are strongly strengthened due to large deformations and their post metalworking is difficult. For this reason, it is necessary to carry out heat treatment for further use of bimetal. The best combinations of bimetal annealing have been determined to obtain high strength and ductility factors, as well as to ensure the layers connection strength. It has been established that a bimetallic composition electrical resistance differs significantly, depending on heat treatment.

articleTitle: The Traction Induction Motor Magnetic Circuit Saturation Influence on the Variable Electric Drive Energy Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Currently, variable frequency induction motors (IM) are widely used as traction machines. This is primarily due to the semiconductor devices improvement, with the help of which the traction IM are powered and the its operation modes are regulated. During the frequency-controlled IM operation, the problem arises at determining their optimal control parameters when the load on the IM shaft changes. As a rule, traction IMs are characterized by a change in the load over a wide range and, therefore, to increase their energy efficiency, it is necessary to use the optimal regulation for the supply voltage and the current magnetization reversal frequency in the IM windings. With wide supply voltage regulation, the magnetic flux saturation in the IM stator core changes in proportion to it. With an increase in the magnetic flux saturation, the stator winding current the reactive component grows nonlinearly, causing an magnetic losses increase and a decrease in the IM efficiency. The article analyzes the frequency-controlled IM operation modes in order to determine their operation optimal mode when the voltage and supply voltage frequency change, taking into account the nonlinear change in the saturation for the IM magnetic system.

articleTitle: Study of the Dynamic Performance of an Electrically Excited Synchronous Machine with Rotary Transformer
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: In this article, the influence of the rotary transformer design parameters on the dynamic performance of the electrically excited synchronous machine (EESM) has been investigated. The model of EESM in the d-q reference frame with the control system has been built and analyzed using Matlab/Simulink software. The main electrical parameters of the rotary transformer were identified and implemented into the equivalent circuit model of EESM based on the parameters of the real machine. Based on the proposed model, the most suitable design parameters for the wireless excitation system were obtained.

articleTitle: Theoretical Research of Vibrations of the Electromechanical Drive of a Technological Machine in Construction Production
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The kinematic diagram is presented, mathematical models of two dual-mass dynamic systems are compiled, given respectively to the input and output shafts of the gear reducer, to describe the vibrations of the electromechanical drive of the working body of a technological machine at variable moments of resistance forces. As a result of solving the obtained differential equations, with the help of complex functions, the laws of torsional vibrations of the rotor of the electric motor and other elements of the electromechanical drive are determined at a harmonic moment of resistance forces. Functional dependences are determined that describe the angles of torsion of the shafting and the dynamic loads of the elements of the electromechanical drive during its torsional vibrations. Recommendations for improving the performance and reliability of the electromechanical drive of a technological machine are given.

articleTitle: Elective Subjects as an Important Component of the Students’ Individual Educational Trajectory Implementation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The research deals with the concept of individual educational trajectory in the aspect of elective subjects and student’s right to freely choose educational component through the prism of student-centered approach in education. Levels of formation and features of implementing the individual educational trajectory in university (in the process of training students of first (bachelor’s) level of higher education) and higher vocational school (in the process of preparing a professional junior bachelor as a pre-tertiary vocational education) specialty 141 Electrical Energetics, Electrical Engineering and Electromechanics. The stages of individual educational trajectory implementation in the context of elective subjects on the example of training junior bachelors are investigated and the specifics of this process are reflected.

Author Keywords: selective component of the educational process

articleTitle: Massive Open Online Courses in the System of E-learning of Masters in Electrical Engineering
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The article presents the technology of implementation of massive open online courses in the system of e-learning of Masters in Electrical Engineering. The developed technology provides an opportunity to combine the learning process in the e-environment of higher education institution with learning in massive open online course, forms analytical skills and ability to share experience with others, to systematically monitor the learning process. The degrees of integration of the massive open online course into the system of e-learning of Masters in Electrical Engineering are described: high, sufficient, intermediate, initial. Optimally selected massive open online courses provide an opportunity to organically integrate them into the educational process. The experiment involved massive open online courses, which were developed according to the curriculum and work programs for Masters in Electrical Engineering, namely: "Electrical Technologies", "Automation of Technological Processes". During the verification of the obtained data using Pearson’s criterion, it was determined that the proposed technology is effective.

articleTitle: Automated Control System for Grain Throwers Based on Fuzzy Logic
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper proposes a grain overload control system for post-harvest processing by grain throwers, the use of which will reduce grain damage and loss. An automated electromechanical system is presented, which can be installed on agricultural machinery without additional modernization of working units. As a result of the analysis of control systems, a system with elements of fuzzy logic was selected, which will allow to clearly define the necessary control actions and take into account additional parameters that may affect the overload process. Practical application of the offered system will allow to reduce material losses from injury of the overloaded grain and to increase efficiency of work of the grain thrower.

articleTitle: Calculation Of Losses In Steel And Improvement Of A Three-Phase Transformer With A Twisted Spatial Magnetic Circuit
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: One of the options for modern improvement of three-phase transformers is the use of symmetric spatial electromagnetic systems with twisted magnetic circuits, which are better than planar analogs in terms of their weight and dimensions. The paper considers the features of calculating losses in steel and proposes technical solutions to improve the distribution of the magnetic field in a twisted butt-shaped spatial magnetic core, which makes it possible to reduce losses in steel and the no-load current of the transformer.

articleTitle: Performance Optimization Algorithm for Electric DriveControl Systems Based on Acceleration Constraint
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Intermediate coordinate limitation levels are the basis for speed optimization of electric drive control systems. However, such levels can vary depending on the features of the dynamic mode, which makes the task of modifying the settings of the regulators relevant. This paper presents an adaptive tuning algorithm for relay control systems with a cascade structure, which is based on the N–i switching method and provides correction of the acceleration limitation level. The presented materials of the study of transient processes indicate the effectiveness of the proposed approach to optimization. The solution justified for electric drives is extended to other second-order systems with a similar structure.

articleTitle: Improving the Energy Efficiency of RES in the Electricity Balance of Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The change dynamic of renewable energy sources (RESs) installed capacity with an uneven generation schedule is investigated in the paper. Ways to ensure the balance reliability of the power system (PS) in conditions of rapid integration of wind and photovoltaic power plants are considered. The composition of the power balance in the power system is analyzed and the equation of the power balance is formed. A comprehensive approach to compensating for the non-uniformity of the RES generation schedule is proposed. A model of redundancy costs depending on the cost of 1kW and installed capacity has been developed using the A Mamdani Fuzzy Inference System.

articleTitle: Method of Space Vector Pulse Width Modulation in High Voltage Cascaded Frequency Converter with Damaged H-cells
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper proposes a control method for a high-voltage cascade frequency converter with H-bridges, based on Space Vector Pulse Width Modulation, regardless of the number of normal and damaged H-cells in phases. Analytical dependencies are given that explain the principle of balancing asymmetric base vectors, and tabular data are provided for the implementation of this method in most possible emergency modes in 4-6-level frequency converters. It was found that the formation of control laws for power switches only taking into account the change in length and phase shifts between the base vectors in emergency modes is not enough to exclude shock electromagnetic and electromechanical processes in an induction motor. Such shocks occur due to the appearance of an additional shift of the phase-to-phase voltages due to the asymmetry of the phase voltages on the half-period of the generated signal. Based on the expansion in a Fourier series, the necessary correcting phase shifts are calculated for all considered emergency modes. Modelling of electromagnetic and electromechanical processes in an electric drive 3.3 MW, 6.6 kV with a 6-level frequency converter has shown the effectiveness of the developed method – during transitions from a normal to an emergency mode, electromagnetic processes caused by phase shifts are excluded. At the same time, SVPWM in all modes increases the energy efficiency of power supplies by 15.6%, which makes it possible to increase the phase-to-phase voltage by 10 ... 26% in emergency modes in comparison with sinusoidal PWM. The proposed analytical dependencies and tabular data can be used in the synthesis of control systems with both scalar and vector control.

Author Keywords: multilevel high-voltage cascaded H-bridge frequency converter
balancing method of Space Vector Pulse Width Modulation.

articleTitle: Exploring the MMF of a Three-Phase Induction Motor with Twelve-Zone Stator Windings
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Currently, the main direction in increasing the energy efficiency of induction motor drive (IMD) is the implementation of control systems, which have the function of regulating technological processes in addition to reducing electricity consumption. However, about 70% of all induction motors (IM) are low and medium power motors being a part of uncontrolled electric drive systems. Therefore, significant savings of fuel and energy resources can be achieved only through the improvement of the energy efficiency of the induction motor itself. One of the most important areas for further improvement of the energy characteristics of the IM is the structure of the stator winding, which in turn will positively affect the conditions of electromechanical conversion. The principles of construction of asymmetric twelve-zone stator windings and possible variants of combination of separate sections are reviewed in the paper. A method for calculating the magnetomotive force (MMF) for a given connection scheme of individual coils of a stator winding and the values of phase currents is suggested. The suggested method for calculating the MMF is implemented in MATLAB. A decrease in the level of higher harmonics of MMF created by an asymmetric twelve-zone winding in comparison with a conventional stator winding design is substantiated, making it possible to predict an improvement in the operational characteristics of an IM with an asymmetric twelve-zone stator winding.

articleTitle: Mathematical Modeling of a Special Induction Motor With a Double Squirrel Cage Rotor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: On the basis of the theory of generalized electromechanical converter the mathematical model of a special induction motor with a double squirrel cage rotor that is presented in the form of a system of ordinary nonlinear differential equations 11 th order. The implementation of this model in MATLAB / Simulink is offered. The adequacy of the obtained model is substantiated by checking its parametric sensitivity and stability of the solution when choosing different numerical methods of integration of systems of differential equations.

Author Keywords: induction motor with a double squirrel cage rotor

articleTitle: Expansion Of Measurement Grid In Field Problems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: integral equations are very often used to solve inverse magnetometry problems. The initial data for them are the results of magnetic field measurements on a closed circuit or a bounded grid. However, mathematical models use infinity integration. Thus, this creates a significant discrepancy between actual and calculated results. Particular attention should be paid to the fact that inverse problems of magnetometry are not stable solutions. A priori information is used to solve them. Thus, there is a need to expand the grid of measurements by creating mathematical modeling. Exactly this is proposed in the study.

articleTitle: dComFra DC-office as a Tool for Digital Skills Development for the Electrical Engineering Students
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper deals with the research on the ways for enhancement digital literacy of the Ukrainian citizens, paying attention to the electromechanical specialists. It was analyzed the ways for digital knowledge improvement, possible solutions which are currently under development worldwide. Main attention was paid to dComFra project, aimed to introduce structural changes into Ukrainian digital literacy education giving the main attention to digital literacy of the citizens in general. The achievements of dComFra project implementations were highlighted. It was singled out the influence of the project results on the development of digital skills for electromechanical specialists.

articleTitle: Active Rectifiers in the Electrical System of Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: This article features an overview of active three-phase rectifiers for autonomous power supply systems that include the electrical system of aircraft. Rectifiers are subject to strict current quality requirements according to the More Electric Aircraft (MEA) concept, which is the dominant trend in aircraft engineering. This article considers four alternate schemes of active rectifiers with a histeresis current control that are powered by a three-phase network with a frequency of 400 kHz. The results of modeling, harmonious composition of current and its compliance with quality standards are described in this article. The comparative characteristic of rectifiers was carried out as well.

articleTitle: The Single-Phase Induction Motor Windings Parameters Experimental Optimization at a Given Capacity of the Phase-Shifting Capacitor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Single-phase induction electric motors (SPIM) are widely used in the modern society life various fields as an electric drive part for the various devices kinds powered by a single-phase AC network. First of all, SPIM have become widespread due to their use in household appliances (refrigeration units, water pumps, woodworking machines, medical equipment), which are constantly evolving, acquiring new functionality and intensively penetrating in the industrialized countries residential and office premises. Electric motors this class belongs to mass-manufacture motors and is produced in units tens millions per year, which determines the manufacturers increased interest to improve SPIM designs and production technology. At the same time, in line with the main world trends in the last decade’s electric motors development, there is a steady preference for improving the electric drives energy efficiency over the active materials cost and SPIM cost production. Therefore, a small improvement in the SPIM energy performance can have a strong impact on energy consumption worldwide and ultimately reduce harmful substances emissions into the environment. This article presents a method to experimentally optimize the SPIM windings parameters values to maximize Efficiency with a given and fixed phase-shifting capacitor. The positive effect when using the proposed method is confirmed by the SPIM industrial tests results of various powers.

articleTitle: The Research of The Dynamics of the Electromechanical Drive of a Concrete Mixer
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: A kinematic diagram is described and dual-mass mathematical models of dynamic systems of an electromechanical drive of a concrete mixer are compiled. As a result of solving the obtained differential equations, the laws of torsional vibrations of the rotor of the electric motor and other elements of the electromechanical drive under the action of the impulse moment of resistance forces are determined using complex functions. The functional dependences describing the angles of torsion of the shafting and the dynamic loads of the elements of the electromechanical drive during its torsional vibrations are determined. Recommendations for improving the performance and reliability of the electromechanical drive of the concrete mixer are given.

articleTitle: Laboratory Model of an Electric Vehicle Charger Based on the Principle of Energy Transfer by Air
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: wireless power transmission has been known for over a hundred years and is a method of transmitting electricity over long distances without the use of a conductive medium. Due to the lack of a conductive element, the main disadvantage of this system is its low efficiency. This paper presents an analysis of this system for an electric vehicle. A simulation model created in COMSOL Multiphysics is presented. The two coils are placed in close proximity and the theoretical efficiency of energy transfer between the coils is analyzed. A laboratory model of such a system is developed for a radio controlled (RC) car model. The experimental measurements are compared with the results of the simulation and summarize the necessary steps to be taken in designing such a system.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an Interleaved DC to DC Buck Converter Controlled and Supervised by the Internet
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: This paper addresses the problem of designing and implementing a DC-to-DC buck converter act as a voltage power supply that is intended to be used as a teaching aid or in any other field where supervision over multiple voltage sources through internet is mandatory. The design addresses the problem of choosing the components and topology of the DC-to-DC buck converter and to create a reliable communication channel between the source and a dedicated server with the use of the MQTT protocol for remote control. The paper contains laboratory model as well as control flowcharts.

articleTitle: Application Of Visualization Systems Based On Augmented Reality Technology In Teaching Students Of Technical Specialties
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper deals with the problems of perception and structuring of educational material. The possibilities of using augmented reality technology for teaching students of technical specialties and reducing psychological anxiety in distance and blended learning are investigated. The prospects of using augmented reality technology to ensure the regional uniqueness of educational programs for technical specialties are shown.

articleTitle: The method for stabilizing the electrical power of a vehicle diesel generator plant
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The article deals with the actual problem associated with the control of the generator power for the purpose of stabilization, depending on the load modes. The proposed device allows on a running engine of diesel generator sets by changing the degree of uneven rotation of the camshaft of the fuel pump, to improve the operation of the engine and to increase the torque on the generator during transient and changing load modes, which is also relevant for transport electromechanical sets. The developed methodology for calculating of this device is presented.

articleTitle: Influence of the Value of the Power Factor of Electricity Consumers in the Residential Sector of the Village on the Technical and Economic Indicators of Low-Voltage Electrical Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The calculation of possible additional electricity losses in rural low-voltage networks for household use in Ukraine for a year with a decrease in the power factor level from 0.96 to 0.77 has been carried out.

Author Keywords: electricity consumption in the residential sector of the village

articleTitle: Concept System of Higher Education Quality Management
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: In the context of deepening social and reform processes taking place in Ukraine, the dominant feature of the development of national education is the introduction of requirements in accordance with which the European emphasis on the assessment and quality standarts and control of education is growing. Improving the process of education quality is a new and main direction in the development of higher education in Europe, which is recognized by European governments, academia, international and intergovernmental organizations, the media. This process is accompanied by changes in the specialized education system and necessitates a scientific search for new mechanisms and methods of managing the educational process, bringing the content of higher education to the requirements and needs of the educational market. In particular, it concerns the application of the principles of Total Quality Management (TQM) and the requirements of international standards ISO 9001 series for the construction of internal quality management systems in educational institutions. The existence of a quality management system is a generally accepted guarantee and confirmation of the quality indicators of education.

articleTitle: Electric Vehicle Slippage Prevention System Based on Fuzzy Logic Controller
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Mathematical and computer models of an asynchronous electric drive of an electric vehicle with a detailed mechanical part, taking into account the mechanical differential, are built to study dynamic processes with a decrease in the coefficient of friction of wheels with a road surface. Computer simulation of dynamic processes in an electric drive during a hitting and starting on a road surface with a reduced coefficient of friction has been carried out. The analysis of time diagrams showed the adequacy of transients and their compliance with physical laws. An algorithm for the slipping beginning recognizing was developed, for which the inconsistency of the speed of the slipping wheel and the reduced speed to angular speed of the electric vehicle was used, which made it possible to synthesize a system for its elimination by the appropriate control of the electric drive. A computer model of the slip prevention system was built using 9 logical processing rules. Computer simulation of the acceleration of an electric vehicle with subsequent slipping by one and two wheels has been carried out. In accordance with the identification algorithm system completely prevents excessive slipping.

articleTitle: Comparison of Hybrid Excitation Synchronous Motor with Sinusoidal and Non-Sinusoidal Back-EMF
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Hybrid excited synchronous machines are getting used wider and have perspectives for being used in many spheres where there is a need in efficient machine with magnetic flux control ability, especially, while prices on permanent magnets are getting higher. Models of synchronous machines with hybrid excitation allows to simulate different operation modes itself and create more complex models including this type of machine. For accurate analysis of hybrid excitation synchronous motor and it`s drive control it is significant to have an accurate model. This paper deals with comparison of synchronous machine with hybrid excitation with non-sinusoidal and sinusoidal back-emf.

articleTitle: Improvement of Technology of Vehicle Electric Motors Casing Repair
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Electric motors are widely used in modern vehicles to drive various mechanisms (power steering, generators, starters, etc.). Normal operation and traffic safety depend on their reliability. Modern repairing technologies make it possible to obtain 70-80% of the secondary resource of the car electric equipment. The solution to the problem of the electric motor cylindrical casing panel homogenous strain is obtained. It showed that in the repair conditions by flattering or expansion-reduction, the casing diameter does not significantly affect the circumferential deformations equality. The workpiece diameter invariability does not affect the high accuracy of the grooves and flanges zones planned final dimensions. Since the tool is a roll-roller, it is universal for flattening and strain of various diameters of the casing cylinders. This is a feature of this repair method and its adaptability to the conditions of single-piece manufacture. To align the casing cylinders out-of-roundness and the dents on them, it is enough to make the operating stroke of the driven roller by 0.5-1 mm of radial infeed, which will lead to plastic tangential and meridional workpiece strain and its flattening. This process does not require large energy costs, since the strain is carried out by the tool locally, in the roll contact zone, which is of great importance in the conditions of repair workshops.

articleTitle: Determination of Electromagnetic Radiation Iintensity by Reaction of Hydro- and Aerobionts
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The purpose of work is to analyze the possibility of estimating and determining the intensity of electromagnetic radiation by the reaction (activity) of model organisms to changes in the levels of magnetic field induction in water and air. The study was conducted using the original method of determining the activity scores of model organisms. Stimulating, suppressing and lethal levels of electromagnetic pollution of water and air for model organisms have been established. Sharp oscillation in the activity of MO due to the influence of magnetic field induction over 1.5 μT.

articleTitle: Simulation of Sucker-Rod Oil Pumping Unit Operation for Marginal Wells
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper proposes a model of the electromechanical control system for the sucker-rod oil pumping unit with the feedback based on the pump filling factor. The structural diagram of the system is presented and its operation algorithm is described. The control system relies on a Hamming network, which determines the level of marginal well filling by recognizing the recorded load curve and generates a control signal. The optimal operation mode for the oil pumping unit is established by setting the rotation speed of the driving motor in accordance with the flow rate of the formation. The simulation of the normal and emergency modes of the oil pumping unit was implemented based on the experimental data.

articleTitle: Remote Microcontroller Scanner Design for STM32 Microcontrollers Used to Distance Education Form
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The novel coronavirus disease (Covid-19) is a global problem that has caused many changes in people's lives. One of the problems is distance education, that has caused a difficulty form of study. Students often do not have required study components, because they are in the home and teacher does not have complete control over them. This paper described remote control and monitor system for the microcontroller technique subject, where the teacher gets possibilities for monitoring each student’s microcontroller program. The subject is focused to the basic peripherals and functionalities of STM32 microcontrollers and internet communication based on the ESP8266 chip. Therefore, the article contains of monitoring module design, remote control application and simple test of the remote-control scanner for STM32 microcontrollers focused to the distance form of study.

articleTitle: Solar Energy Advancement in Ukraine’s Households: is the Feed-In Tariff Economically Justified?
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper deals with assessing the effectiveness of investment projects for constructing solar power plants in Ukraine’s households. The state policy measures to stimulate solar energy development and its influence on the rapid deployment of solar power plants in Ukraine’s households are analyzed. The cost of electricity generation, the rate of the feed-in tariff, and the payback period of investment projects for the construction of solar power plants with an installed capacity of 30 kW were estimated. Calculations show that the payback period of investment projects at the current feed-in tariff rate in Ukraine is 5.1 years. This payback period provides a quick return on start-up investment and a significant income for households’ owners from the sale of surplus electricity not consumed for their purposes. Based on the analysis of the payback period of such projects in other countries, recommendations are given for revising energy policy, particularly in reducing the feed-in tariff to a rate that will ensure a payback period of investment projects not less than eight years.

articleTitle: Simulation Study of Electric Drive and Industrial Plants with New Smart Controller
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: This paper presents the simulation results of electric drives and industrial plants by using new smart controller with fixed parameters. Transient response of multiple linear and nonlinear plants with changing of control signals and disturbances are considered.

articleTitle: Transformations of Educational Technologies
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Modern development of society takes place in an environment of dynamic changes, transformational challenges of global and local scale, which determine the multifaceted processes of development. Thus, Industry 4.0, which focuses on technical, technological, informational aspects, is being replaced by the concept of the future of 5.0, the main idea of which is the humanistic orientation of development in the digital information space. Education, as one of the basic components of social development, a priori on the one hand reflects the existing trends, and on the other - should ensure the formation of strategic innovation processes in all spheres of human activity. The purpose of the article is to justify the directions of formation of innovative educational space according to the model "Education 5.0" in the context of ensuring the quality of the educational program, in particular for the training of specialists for the Electrical and Energy System. Research methods are abstraction, analysis and synthesis, systematization, analytical generalizations, foresight and forecasting of the implementation of the provisions of the concept of the future 5.0 in the educational environment. The results of the study: generalization of the main challenges and directions of their implementation in the educational process; presentation of the model of the quality assurance system of a higher education institution (HEI) taking into account the nine basic components; substantiation of the main directions of strategic changes in determining the trajectories of formation and implementation of educational programs, in particular for the training of specialists for the Electrical and Energy System. The proposed approach will ensure the creation of a system to increase the competitiveness of the educational program as a basic precondition for the formation of professionals taking into account the requirements and principles of society 5.0.

articleTitle: The Electrodes Positioning Control System for the Electric Arc Furnace Basing on Fuzzy Logic
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The expediency of using the fuzzy logic principles to improve the dynamics of the electric arc furnace (EAF) electrodes positioning control is substantiated. The analysis of the electric mode (EM) control laws is carried out and the model of phase-asymmetric law based on the fuzzy logic principles is proposed. We have developed the structural scheme for its realization and performed the synthesis. A three-phase instantaneous coordinates computer model of the EAF EM control system was compiled using the proposed fuzzy law. We have performed a study of the control dynamics under the influence of phase-asymmetric deterministic and stationary random perturbations by arc lengths. The analysis of the research results demonstrated that the use of the proposed fuzzy law improves the indices of deterministic and random perturbations handling in comparison with the known differential law.

articleTitle: Influence of Voltage Deviation and Asymmetry on Transitional Processes in Asynchronous Electric Drive
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Investigations of electromagnetic and electromechanical transients in an asynchronous electric drive with voltage deviation and asymmetry have been carried out. Analytical expressions are obtained that describe the transients in an asynchronous electric drive with a shock load at voltage deviation and asymmetry.As the voltage decreases and asymmetries, the electromechanical constant of time increases, and as the voltage increases, electromechanical constant decreases. As a result, in drives with a small electromechanical time constant, increasing the voltage can cause torques and speed to fluctuate, while reducing and asymmetry can eliminate them.In electric drives with a large moment of inertia, the transient process is aperiodic. When the voltage is higher than the nominal one, the duration of the transient process decreases, and when the voltage decreases and asymmetries, duration of the transient process increases.The decrease and asymmetry of the voltage causes a decrease in the steady angular speed compared to the nominal, and an increase in voltage - angular speed increase.

articleTitle: Current Harmonics Distribution Influence of a Traction Transformer Secondary Winding on a Power Losses Level Taking Into Account Distortion Power
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The article deals with the study of power distribution in the traction substation power transformer of railway transport quarry. The calculation methods analysis of voltage and current harmonic components, and also corresponding distortions is carried out. It is assumed that each harmonic of current or voltage affects the power distribution in the transformer differently. In the visual environment, a model was created to study the effect of individual harmonics, or their combinations on the power distribution in the traction transformer. Using the experiment planning methods, a research plan was drawn up - a central compositional plan with star points. A series of experiments based on the calculations results using modern software for statistical calculations obtained regression equations and indicators that reflect a high level of adequacy. It is established that in the studied case the level of the current third harmonic has the highest significance.

articleTitle: Control System for Agricultural Robot Based on ROS
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: This paper presents a control system for a special purpose mobile platform using ROS capabilities. The structure of hardware and software is given. The main nodes of the control system that have been developed are described: the structure of the motion control node of the mobile platform, the structure of Sensor Node, Navigation Node, Power Node. An example of the control module work of linear and angular velocity by means of sensors is given. The Robot System node graph is constructed and the main stages of processing the information received by means of sensors are described. Data from three sources are used to plot the trajectory: an odometer from the wheels (data from the motor driver), an odometer from the encoders and an IMU sensor. The combination of information from three sources is performed using a Kalman filter. Experimental data of test results of the operating mobile platform in the form of graphs of linear and angular velocity of the platform are also given.

articleTitle: Technical Solutions of Laminated Magnetic Cores of Transformers With Combination of Electrical Steel
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: One of the goals of energy conservation is to reduce the waste and material intensity of transformers. The improvement of transformers is traditionally determined by the creation of new materials. Modern transformers are based on magnetic conductors of anisotropic electrical steels. The lack of flexible magnetic circuits made of such steels is a great additional loss in the angular zones when the direction of magnetic flux does not correspond to the texture of steel. The aim of the work is to analyze and present transformer improvement possibilities by structural-geometric transformations of magnetic conductors. In addition to the use of new materials, the improvement of transformers is possible with innovative design and technological solutions. Combinations and changes of configurations and positions of steel layers of charged magnetic circuits are offered. To avoid significant additional losses, the rods and jugular sections are made of anisotropic steel, and isotropic steel plates are installed in angular zones. The combinations of plates of anisotropic and isotropic steels are usefully formed and connected in integral blanks by electric welding. It is also possible to reduce losses and material intensity of transformers by constructing circuits of three-phase and one-phase magnetic circuits based on octagonal and hexagonal configurations.

articleTitle: Power Consumption Mode Investigation of a Transformer with Asymmetric Load under the Condition of Active Parts Temperature Change
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Nonlinear load causes leakage of non-sinusoidal currents and voltages in the transformer, that carrying a spectrum of higher harmonics violate the thermal balance of the transformer, creating zones of high heating, disrupt the circulation of cooling around the active parts of the transformer and accelerate the aging of insulating materials. The paper presents a study of a transformer with an asymmetric load under the condition of changing the temperature of the active parts. The work purpose is investigation the relationship between the influences of temperature changes of the transformer active parts on the power consumption mode with asymmetric load. The transformer equavalent circuit equations with introduction of parameters dependence on the temperature change for one of the phases are used, as well as the balance equation of the transformer power components. The equations are presented for influence of temperature change on material parameters of primary or secondary windings and the magnetization path of transformer equivalent circuit, as well as for the balance of power flow components. Experimental researches of the laboratory transformer with asymmetric loading are carried out. In the course of experimental studies it was found that the temperature has an effect on the properties of the steel of the active parts of the transformer, creating the preconditions for the unbalanced distribution of magnetic flux values, power and THD current phases, increasing the negative impact on operation and transformer service life. The obtained results can be applied in the tasks of monitoring and forecasting of anomalies during operation of the transformer in the asymmetric loading mode.

articleTitle: Python-based Induction Motors Monitoring and Lifetime Estimation System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The aim of this paper is to investigate and use modern technologies for induction motor condition analysis. Development of the modeling and prognosis instruments allow to increase efficiency of induction motor diagnosis quality and provide efficient maintenance. Non-intrusive parameters analysis methods significantly reduce costs and provide enough information for condition evaluation. Induction motor lifetime reduction caused by insulation overheating was taken as a basic parameter. According to Montsinger's rule was created Python-based environment for evaluating additional losses that cause overheating. The user's interface provides processed information, recommended repair schedule, and expected induction motor lifetime. Based on the model of the motor also provided a chart with expected exploitation costs. This prognosis is expanded with calculations and charts for additional spending caused by power supply asymmetry. The presented system supports extensions and will receive parameters from other units during the development process.

articleTitle: Minimization of the Description of Images in the Problem of Adaptive Control of Static Technological Objects
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: When controlling static objects at the optimization level, pattern recognition methods are used that allow partitioning the factor space into elementary subdomains in the form of n-dimensional hyperparallelepipeds. One of the main elements of the control structure for this approach to control is the adaptation algorithm, that makes it possible to refine the description of a static object under nonstationarity conditions. Repeated use of the adaptation algorithm to refine the model leads to an unjustified complication of its logical structure and the accumulation of information that has lost its relevance. The paper proposes a method for minimizing the description of images of technological situations, that makes it possible to overcome the indicated disadvantages. The method is based on the property of invariance of the number of parameters defining the hyperparallelepiped to the size of the described area in the factor space. This made it possible to identify significant boundary sub-areas in the description of the image of technological situations and, by their subsequent combination in the direction of the feature axes, to select a description with a minimum number of sub-areas. When performing these operations, "outdated" information is removed and the logical structure of a static control object is simplified as much as possible. The paper shows the possibility of implementing an algorithm for minimizing the description of images on the basis of α-algebra, that makes it possible to integrate its control structures using relational data models. The effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is confirmed by computational experiments in the control of the process of lump crushing for the conditions of a mining and processing plant.

Author Keywords: method for minimizing the description of images

articleTitle: Synchronous Drive with Dual-Zone Speed Control
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The vector control of the angular speed of the synchronous electric drive is submitted. The field weakening mode is used to limit the inverter voltage in the second zone. The reference trajectories of the angular velocity of the rotor and their limited derivatives of the first order, which form the reference signals for the field component and the moment component of the stator current vector based on the strategy Field Weakening Control, are shown. The influence of the given trajectories of the angular velocity of the rotor of an electric motor on the dynamic parameters of the vector system is investigated. Control of electromechanical coordinates of the electric drive is carried out at the expense of application of regulators which are developed on the basis of inverse problems of dynamics.

Author Keywords: surface mounted permanent magnet synchronous motor

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Smart Glasses Solution in Electromechanical Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The article describes intelligent devices focused to smart glasses, analyze the technology of smart glasses belonging to the group of wearable devices and their possible use in the electromechanical systems.
