It may happen that smart glasses will be in the center of business electronics in future, similar to today’s smartphones. The article presents design of smart glasses software, it handles about software link between electric drives controlled by Siemens PLC and Android OS. This link provides the control process data visualization and its control. Automated process applications are available for development to enhance control automation processes. There are several smart glasses types, with different operating system, camera type, resolution, shape, control system etc. The proposed software is built into Android Studio and tested via the emulator. Because the app was created for specific smart glasses, the emulator eyeglass maker was used. Emulator is an application on a mobile phone serving as a representation of physical glasses. The emulator is an app on a cellphone emulating physical glasses.

articleTitle: Mathematical modeling of a contact metal-porous GaAs
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The issue of constructing a mathematical model of contact to a porous layer of gallium arsenide is considered. It is shown that thermionic emission is the main mechanism that determines the current flow in the metal contact - porous gallium arsenide system. An expression is obtained that determines the relationship between the contact resistance and the porosity of a gallium arsenide film. A mathematical model has been developed that describes the dependence of the total resistance of the metal contact-porous layer of gallium arsenidegallium arsenide substrate on the porosity of the film, and it is shown that with an increase in the thickness of the porous film, the total resistance increases. To assess the adequacy of the developed mathematical model of the metal-porous gallium arsenide contact with the Schottky barrier, current-voltage characteristics were constructed and the total contact resistance was calculated for experimental samples with different porous layer thicknesses. The discrepancy between the simulation results and experimental data does not exceed 20%.

articleTitle: Energy Indicators Of A Cylindrical Magneto-Electric Sea Wave Energy Converter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Ways to increase energy performance in cylindrical three-phase magneto-electric generators with permanent magnets to convert sea wave’s energy into electricity are considered on basis of a developed method for analysis of electromagnetic processes. Increasing energy performance of each size cylindrical magneto-electric generators for converting sea wave’s energy into electrical energy are developed here taking into account real character of rotor’s motion. Energy indicators of cylindrical magneto-electric generators for converting sea wave’s energy depend on electrical load, design of the generator and parameters of sea waves.

articleTitle: Discrete-Pulse Voltage Control of an Asynchronous Generator
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper proposes a discrete-pulse method and its circuit implementation of voltage control of an asynchronous generator, which provides a high speed of the voltage stabilization system without modulation in steady-state modes. The paper presents the results of modeling transient processes for a saturated and unsaturated asynchronous machine with the proposed discrete-pulse control law when turning on and off 75% of a static active-inductive load.

articleTitle: Project-Based Learning for Responsible Education: Empirical Study of the Additional Value for Students
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: In this research the authors investigate the potential of project-based learning in making students of higher educational institutes more engaged and gain a deep understanding of the curriculum content. The literature review presents the main definitions and benefits of project-based learning (PBL), followed by its contribution to improving the performance of students’ training. The results of the research are based on testing the main statements of PBL empirically - if it really can provide additional value for learners in higher education. The empirical data have been collected based on Ukrainian case study and allow the authors to prove the influence of PBL on increasing students’ engagement, satisfaction, performance and improving learning outcomes.

articleTitle: Influence of Plastic Deformation on Cross-Section Area of Electrical Contacts
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The cross-sectional area of electrical contacts is the most important characteristic of their resilient and reliable operation. Increase of the area leads to the boost of the number of electrons passing through the cross-section over a period of time, which magnifies the current density. Manufacture of electrical circuit contacts requires techniques that allow keeping the cross-section area of the finished part unchanged. Below, we present experimental data on the bending of flat plates to obtain contacts with a bent axis. Statistical processing of the experiment results on the bending of flat electrical contacts shows that thickness of the finished product at the bending point neither significantly changes and nor depends on the method of plastic deformation. However, the average thickness of the plate bent with increased edging support is 5% larger than the plate obtained using the traditional technology. Although these results lie within the range of permissible errors, they make it possible to evaluate the effect of the support on the geometry of the cross-section of the detail. There is a tendency to an increase in the thickness of the electrical contact with curved axis during its manufacture by the method of bending with the support of the plate ends. The results obtained are intermediate (a small experiments number, optimal deformation conditions selection), however, they make it possible to determine the further developments directions in the problem of increasing the electrical contacts cross-sectional area manufactured by pressure treatment methods.

articleTitle: Augmented Reality Technology in the System of Modern Education: Philosophical and Pedagogical Aspects
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The article considers the augmented reality technology and emphasizes the relevance of its implementation in education in the context of information society formation. A brief overview of different technologies used in AR is given. The advantages and approaches to the use of augmented reality technology as a means of educating students are highlighted and examples of these approaches implementation in the educational process are given. It is concluded that the use of augmented reality technology in education as an additional catalyst in education is unequivocal. Significantly expanding the tools of modern educators, AR technology improves the process of presenting educational material, enhances its learning effect, increases motivation to learn and the overall level of students’ interest in mastering academic disciplines.

articleTitle: Design of Autonomous Temperature Measurement by Microcontroller with Wi-Fi Module
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: This article deals with the topic of autonomous temperature measurement. It presents the basic concepts needed to work with a temperature sensor and a microcontroller that contains a Wi-Fi module. The measured data are then distributed to a remote Thingspeak server, where they are visualized and further mathematically processed. This concept can be used to remotely measure different physical quantities, not just temperature. Therefore, this design is applicable in various fields of electrical engineering, electromechanics and power engineering.

articleTitle: Automation of the Power Plant with Variable Parameters of the Optimization Criterion
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Scientific novelty of the work consists in use of the proposed method of optimal control of biogas installation, as well as partial automation of the energy complex. In addition, the increase in biogas can be from 1 to 2.6 per cent during 30-days non-stop operation of the system. In additional, a signal corresponding to the effective operation of the system was determined, ie the criterion of optimality, characterized in that it has a flexible structure and can take values ranging from the maximum value added criterion to the efficiency criterion values. The technical result consists in reducing energy consumption during the production of biogas by means of full or partial non-stop loading of the system.

articleTitle: Fault Detecting of Turnouts Using DWT and ANN
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The problem considered in the work is concerned to fault detection of turnouts. Turnouts are one of the most safety-critical components of the railway infrastructure, faults of which lead to significant delays in train movement and can also cause serious accidents. To ensure the safe operation of the turnouts, they need to be maintained periodically, which is mainly done manually and is very expensive. For fault detection in turnouts, it is convenient to use the dependences of their operating current on time. The development of a reliable method for diagnosing turnouts consists in the need to obtain a sufficiently large number of measured dependences of the operating current on time for all possible malfunctions of turnouts necessary to find statistically patterns or train artificial neural network. The paper proposes to preprocess the time-dependences of the turnouts operating current using a discrete wavelet-packet transform, which allows to extract simple and clear features of turnouts faults and, accordingly, reduce the size of the required dataset for training artificial neural network and accelerate the learning process. The results confirmed effectiveness of using the discrete wavelet-packet transform and an artificial neural network-based classifier for detecting turnouts faults

articleTitle: Fiber Bragg Grating-Based Monitoring System for Large Generator Core Clamping Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: In this paper technology and device for automated detection of the location and size of defects in the stator core of a powerful turbine generator (TG) during assembly at the manufacturing plant is proposed. The core assembled and pressed in a vertical position in separate parts and at each stage of assembly, it is necessary to find places with a weakened solidity. Existing control methods, including automatic ones, will not allow quality control. Using the proposed technology, places in the core with weakened solidity can detected. In this case, measurements of the specific pressing pressure carried out at certain points of the end surface of the core, where special control samples from an easily deformable material installed. The device implemented as a ring installed on the end surface of the core, in which N cells with control samples installed. During pressing, the thickness of the samples decreases and the greatest decrease in the thickness of the sample, caused by the corresponding highest specific pressure, corresponds to the smallest defect, and contrariwise. Flat metal membrane with a rigid center as a primary pressure transducer proposed to use, on which an optical fiber with fiber Bragg grating sensor grid, one of which measures the tangential relative deformation in the membrane, and the second serves for thermal compensation. Tangential deformation in a flat membrane depends on the value of the specific pressing pressure was shown. The characteristics of the converter are calculated. The measurement results processed using an interrogator and a personal computer. The use of the device makes it possible to increase labor productivity when monitoring the core, as well as more reliably diagnose its defects with their subsequent elimination, which ultimately will increase the reliability of the TG and its durability.

articleTitle: Problems of Mathematical Modeling of Thermal Processes in Electric Machines
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The work is devoted to the problems that arise during the construction of mathematical models of heat transfer processes in electric machines during their operation. The electric machine is considered as a complex multilayer electromechanical system with different conditions of heat exchange between the layers, some of which have heat sources of different nature. The radial section of the machine, from a geometric point of view, has the form of a complex area consisting of circles and a 2-n petal rose. Complex system - multilayer cylinder includes movable and fixed layers with different thermophysical properties, rotating at a constant angular velocity around its axis. A mathematical model of temperature distribution in radial sections of an electric machine is constructed, which takes into account the nature of heat exchange at the interface of the structural elements of the machine. The model allows you to calculate the temperature of individual parts of an electric machine. The problem that arises during the construction of mathematical models which is the uncertainty of the conditions of heat exchange between the inner layers of the machine at an unknown temperature on the surfaces of the inner layers is considered. The mathematical model of the thermal process in an electric machine is considered as a boundary value problem for the thermal conductivity equation in a multilayer region with different thermophysical properties of the layers. A method for solving boundary value problems is proposed, which allows to solve the problem of uncertainty of heat exchange conditions between the inner layers in the multilayer region. Numerical experiments were performed and graphs of temperature distributions in an electric machine were constructed.

articleTitle: Reducing the Operating Resource of the Induction Motor Bearings During the Modernization of Shaping Machines
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: It is shown that the modernization of shaping machines by installing an additional pressing tool causes an increase in the resultant shaping forces and, as a consequence, an increase in the load on the supports of the pressure rolls and electric motor shafts. Bearing loads lead to elastic deformations on the contact surfaces between the rolling elements and the raceways. Shaft deformation caused by applied loads results in slight misalignment of the outer and inner rings. Due to the fatigue of the metal of the contacting surfaces of the raceways and rolling elements, flaky particles can separate from the material from which the bearing is made. This leads to a sharp decrease in the fatigue life of electric motor bearings. Therefore, the increase in load must be taken into account at the design stage of modernization techniques and, if necessary, a shorter service life of electric motors between technical inspections and overhauls must be contemplated. Such measures will contribute to improving the reliability and stability of the operation of electric motors.

articleTitle: Manufacture of Electrical, Electronic, Optical Equipment and Ensuring Innovation Security
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The article explores production of computers, electronic and optical products and electrical equipment from the perspective of innovation activity and its role in the formation of Industry 4.0. Attention is drawn to the necessity of ensuring innovation security. Key innovation indicators of production of computers, electronic and optical products and electrical equipment have been analysed. Types of innovation introduced by Ukrainian companies in various sectors and coefficients of innovation efficiency and utilization rate of innovative products are considered. The results of the study show that ensuring innovation security in production of computers, electronic and optical products and electrical equipment will accelerate the safe transition to Industry 4.0.

articleTitle: Modeling Actuators in Systems for Stabilization of Observation Equipment
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper deals with designing the actuator as a part of the system assigned for stabilization information and measurement devices operated on moving vehicles. The united model of the stabilization object and actuator taking into consideration their spring linkage is developed. Simulation of the transient process by absolute, translational angular rates and dynamical error has been carried out. The obtained results prove the possibility to satisfy requirements to accuracy and dynamical properties during stabilization of observation equipment. The obtained results can be useful for designing actuators in control systems of a wide class.

articleTitle: Development of Portable Induction Furnace for MSME Sector
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: From the early age of metalwork, India is in the front line of the development of metal technology which proves from recent excavations in the Middle Ganges Valley that show iron working in India may have begun as early as 1800 BCE. For the melting of metal, the traditional method is used in many sectors in India, which makes environmental hazards as well as adversaries for human health & weakening the economy. In this paper, a portable induction heater is developed to eradicate the ongoing heat treatment system which uses coal. It is an attempt towards eco-friendly energy utilization and it also reduces the public health hazards. The induction heating is a non-contact process, occurs in the target metal itself, and it is considered more efficient than the traditional heating methods of metal. The unit is developed for a social cause, and it is intended to benefit the micro, small and medium enterprises (MSME) sector, located in Bankura district of West Bengal, where mainly the health conditions of the workers in the industry get drastically deteriorated due to the adverse effects of using coal. The model provides a cheap, time-efficient, and a safe alternative to the conventional method. Therefore, it will be a cost effective and efficient tool for the MSME sectors.

articleTitle: The Numerical Analysis of Vibration Parameters in the Working Element of Twin-Screw EectromechanicalHydrolyser for Poultry by-Products Processing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The study of vibration parameters occurring in the working element of the experimental device for processing by-products of poultry farming under the influence of a magnetic field by building a mathematical model by the finite element method was carried out in this work. The mathematical model was developed taking into account the design features of the device's ferromagnetic rotor. Based on the results of a mathematical study, graphs of the dependence of the electromagnetic moment of a ferromagnetic rotor as a function of time, electromagnetic forces in the rotor acting in the transverse and axial directions and the frequency spectrum of electromagnetic forces were obtained.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Methods for Calculating Building Energy Performance
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper highlights the analysis of the advantages and disadvantages of building energy performance calculation methods, which provides an opportunity to assess the feasibility of their further integration into thermal energy consumption control systems as a means of predicting thermal loads.

articleTitle: Experimental Study of Processes in the Elements of Thermochemical Fuel Treatment Systems of Integrated Power Generating Units
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The results of the experimental study of the regularities of processes in the elements of thermochemical fuel treatment through the utilization of secondary energy resources have been presented in the article. As criteria for evaluating the energy efficiency of the processes of thermochemical treatment of hydrocarbon fuels have been proposed: the coefficient of increasing the calorific value of the base fuel and the energy utilization coefficient. Criteria for evaluating the energy efficiency of the processes of thermochemical treatment of hydrocarbon fuels have been proposed. The scheme of the experimental stand and the research methodology have been represented. The results of a comprehensive analysis of the influence of the process parameters of thermochemical processing of the base fuel on the efficiency of steam conversion have been described. Experimental study has been carried out in the range of water vapour/ethanol ratio 0.3... 2.7, pressure 0.175... 0.45 MPa, temperature 850... 950 K. By the method of experiment planning, the dependencies of indicated criteria for evaluating the energy efficiency on the process parameters have been obtained. It has been shown that the influence of the process pressure is essential. In the specified range of parameters for ethanol, the maximum value of the coefficient of increasing the calorific value of the base fuel reaches 0.21. Mechanical energy consumption when organizing the processes of thermochemical treatment is 6... 12% of the total energy costs and significantly affects the efficiency of utilization of secondary energy resources.

articleTitle: Optimization of Informative Signals Stability Along the Waveguides
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper demonstrates that combined ultra-mechanical treatment, ultrasound and mechanical treatment (friction) simultaneously is an effective way to improve surface quality, which allows to optimize the stability of transmitting informative signal along the waveguides. The best treatment parameters, which provide for the increase of hardness, equal distribution of stress, decrease of the product’s surface roughness, were defined.

articleTitle: Why High-Order Integrators Not Rational on Electrical Systems' Computer Calculation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The article considers the problem of using high-order numerical integrators to solve the problem of finding transients in electric circuits. The research conducted using explicit Adams formulas from the first to the fifth order and a simple model of the first order inertial block (circuit). Using the above formulas, discrete transfer functions of those models of the first order block obtained, based on which the presence of additional zeros and poles in the obtained discrete transfer functions in comparison with the continuous system shown. According to the research results, the irrationality of using high-order numerical methods for the analysis of the electrical systems' dynamics confirmed.

articleTitle: Control of a Hybrid Excited Synchronous Generator of an Autonomous Wind Turbine Unit
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The application of hybrid excited synchronous generator (HESG) for an autonomous wind turbine unit is studied. It`s application allows to get a maximum output power of wind turbine in a case of wind speed change by controlling the excitation current of generator. The control algorithms of excitation current and HESP output power are developed on the basis of concept of reverse task of dynamics in combination with minimization of local functionals of instantaneous values of electromagnetic energies, that ensured high control quality, dynamic system decomposition and simplicity of controllers implementation. The study of control process of HESG for an autonomous wind turbine unit on the example of experimental sample has shown the system take maximum output power from wind turbine with dynamic error approximately 0,04% in a case of wind speed change from 3 to 8 m/s.

articleTitle: Single-Loop Relay Control System with Reference Model Based on Discrete Time Equalizer
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Recently, the development of synthesis methods aimed at providing the required quality metrics in case of insensitivity to external disturbances and parametric changes in the control object continues. In this sense, discontinuous nonlinear control remains a promising direction. The most well-known electromechanical systems with discontinuous control are relay systems, which involve the use of two-position regulators (on/off). The concept of perturbed-unperturbed motion and Lyapunov's theory of stability are often used for relay systems synthesis. According to this concept, the system should have a program control setting unit. In this case, the required program control is selected based on the formation of the desired movement trajectory at the system output. Another element of the system is a software-based generator of unperturbed motion, which acts as a reference model. This paper shows that quantized desired transient functions can be used as a basis for the formation of undisturbed motion. Settings on the quantized desired transient functions of finite duration are performed by a regulator called a discrete time equalizer. Implemented in software, the discrete time equalizer allows the formation of unperturbed motion in a system built in accordance with the concept of perturbed-unperturbed motion. By combining discrete time equalizer into one software module with a setting unit, software ideal movement generation subsystem of the optimal relay control system is formed.

articleTitle: Research of Processes in an Autonomous Induction Generator with Relay Regulation of Capacitive Current
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The article deals with the aspects of voltage stabilization of an induction generator in a system with a capacitive current relay regulator. Simulation is carried out by the process in an induction generator with capacitor excitation with relay regulation of capacitive current. The parameters of the relay system are determined when creating an autonomous power source based on induction generators. The proposed voltage regulation method was tested on a 2.2 kW induction generator. The simulation results obtained using the mathematical model were compared with the characteristics obtained using the experimental setup.

articleTitle: Model Building for the Organization of Passenger Transport in Urban Agglomerations
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Annotation–At the present stage of the development of transport infrastructure, the system of servicing the population of urban agglomerations needs to develop an effective package of measures to improve the process of organizing passenger transportation. At the same time, improving the quality of passenger service should be considered taking into account the mobility of the population and the availability of information services. In order to find promising solutions to this problem, the methods used to solve transport problems have been analyzed; it was revealed that the most common is modeling and algorithmization. The prospects for using the metaheuristic method – a genetic algorithm – are justified and the main features of its application are determined. It has been proved that it allows you to take into account the required number of restrictions when looking for an option for a progressive change in the transport system. The chromosome structure and the corresponding decision-making algorithm for the optimal functioning of the passenger transport system have been developed.

articleTitle: Approximation of Transfer Function With a Characteristic Equation in a Fractional Order Binomial Form
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The approximation of one of the desired fractional order transfer functions characterized by the absence of zeros and the expression of a fractional characteristic polynomial in the form of a fractional order binomial are considered. For the purpose of approximation, it is proposed to first implement the approximation of a fractional characteristic polynomial and then write the approximated transfer function as the expression inverse to the approximated characteristic polynomial. The approximation of the characteristic polynomial of the fractional order is carried out by means of a chain fraction. The inverse Laplace transformation is applied for a comparative analysis of the dynamic properties of systems described by the fractional order desired transfer function and the systems described by approximated transfer functions. Consequently, the expression of the system reference transition function described by the desired fractional order transfer function is obtained. It is shown that for such approximation it is sufficient to use expressions of integer order, where the highest degree of the Laplace operator does not exceed two (second-order approximation). It is revealed that the adequacy of such systems frequency characteristics depends on the approximation order. It is necessary to choose higher order of approximation in order to expand the range of frequencies for which the frequency characteristics of the approximated transfer function will coincide with the frequency characteristics of the desired fractional order transfer function.

articleTitle: Feedback Linearized Robust Control of Looper Electric Drives for Hot Rolling Mills
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The method of synthesis of nonlinear robust control by looper position electric drives for hot rolling mills as two-mass electromechanical systems is developed. The method is based on feedback linearizing of initial nonlinear mathematical model of looper electric drives in to linear mathematical model. The result of modeling of dynamic characteristics of a synthesized nonlinear looper position electric drives for various values of the plant parameters is considered.

Author Keywords: looper position electric drives electromechanical servo system

articleTitle: High Operation Speed Iterative Multichannel Feed Electric Drive For Heavy Cutting Machines
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The specified kinematic scheme and mathematical model of the steady motion at metal working mode (face milling) of high-precision and fast iterative multichannel differential-geared cutting machine feed electric drive with essential inertia working tool are obtained. The comparative estimation in temporary and frequency areas of operation speed raise quality performances by means of the proposed iterative multichannel electric drive is executed. Comparison is made with analogous to destination, but various on operation speed, the modern one-channel direct-drive feed electric drives traditionally applied on cutting machines. It is shown, that in the compensated two-and three-channel electric drive in comparison even with the fast one-channel asynchronous feed electric drive with frequency-current vector control essential decrease of transients settling time of on position practically in all range of working tool displacement can be attained.

articleTitle: The Prospects for Applying Auger Heat-Electromechanical Converters as Part of Multipurpose Mobile Robotic Platforms
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: As an alternative to existing approaches, a universal mobile robotic platform equipped with a auger heat-electromechanical converter is proposed. The proposed converter uses an external rotor-auger for rotary motion and an internal stationary shaft for sampling without soil rotation. The data obtained on the spatial distribution of magnetic induction and eddy current density in the active part of the auger heat-electromechanical converter are an important stage on the way to further numerical experiments, in particular, to perform a series of accurate postprocessor calculations to obtain mechanical characteristics. This, in turn, will contribute to development of auger converters optimal design for universal mobile robotic platforms, as well as a strategy for controlling their movement.

articleTitle: The Criteria for the Development of the Eco-Friendly Concept in the Energy Sector
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Many developed countries and corporations that are considered business giants are active participants in the fourth industrial revolution: State programs, commercial and non-commercial associations and organizations are being created with the goal of eliminating barriers to the creation of Industry 4.0. But in their eagerness to maximize profits by being the first to enter the market with new solutions, both corporations and governments risk underestimating the possible negative social consequences of the new vector of technological progress. In this context, the gradual implementation of eco-friendly technologies in the products of the electrical engineering industry is of particular importance. The research has outlined the necessity to make a “green” transition as a driver of the long-term development of the national economy, particularly in terms of overcoming the effects of COVID-19, a chronic respiratory disease caused by the coronavirus. The calculations have shown that the current model of the electricity market is subject to manipulation, which leads to the bankruptcy of systemic enterprises in the energy market and prevents the further development of the national economy. A package of initiatives and recommendations resolving problematic issues in the energy sector and ensuring the sustainable development of alternative energy has been formed.

articleTitle: Plastic Deformation of Crimp Sleeves of Electric Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: We have obtained the dependence for the calculation of the required force under the local plastic deformation of a splicing sleeve of an electric wire. This formula can be used in design calculations to make a crimping tool with regulated crimping force. Due to it one can produce strong integral electrical contacts with guaranteed operating period. The force that is necessary for plastic deformation will increase if the thickness and diameter of a piece part go up and it will decrease if the length of a piece part goes down. Every press will increase the required force since there are changes in the piece part secant modulus, which characterizes the material hardening in the process of plastic deformation.

articleTitle: Experimental Studies of Effectiveness of Active Screening of the Magnetic Field by Single Compensation Winding
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The problem of reducing of the magnetic field generated by overhead power lines by means of active screening is considered. For the first time experimental studies of active screening of the magnetic field generated by a three-phase single-circuit power transmission line with a horizontal arrangement of wires have been carried out. A system of active screening includes only one single compensation winding. Experimental studies of the effectiveness of shielding the magnetic field with open and closed control algorithm, as well as with different spatial arrangement of the magnetic field sensor, have been carried out. It has been experimentally confirmed the possibility of reducing the level of induction of initial magnetic field in a given zone by 3-5 times and in a limited area of the considered space by 15-20 times by system of active screening of a magnetic field with only one single compensation winding.

articleTitle: Synthesis and Study of Derivatives Observer with Sliding Mode Control for Servo Drive
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The structure of the information-measuring system has a decisive influence on the performance attributes of electric drives. In the presented study, the use of measured intermediate coordinates to improve the accuracy of the derivatives observer of the controlled coordinate is considered using example of a third-order system. The proposed structural solution provides an efficient implementation of optimal position control algorithms. The given examples of parametric synthesis for sliding mode control systems of an electric drive and an observer, demonstrate the simplicity of the mathematical apparatus of the N-i switching method.

articleTitle: Designing a Neural Adaptive Control System by Method of Analytical Design of Aggregated Nonlinear Regulator for Control an Induction Motor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: This paper includes the calculation and construct of a nonlinear controller using the method of analytical construct of aggregate regulators (ACAR), with subsequent modification by introducing the mechanism of artificial neural networks. Using the ACAR method allows to synthesize the control laws of nonlinear multidimensional and multiconnected objects, and together with the advantages for building control systems provided by artificial neural networks (ANN), forms a tool for building control systems for complex dynamic objects. The proposed method provides quantitative and qualitative indicators of transients of the induction motor in the presence of mechanical defects, defects of the stator and rotor windings, etc.

articleTitle: Brushless DC Motor Sensorless Controller With Extended Speed Range
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: A brushless DC motor sensorless control algorithm is proposed. The features of the proposed approach are: simplified BLDC controller circuitry, absence of dedicated zero-crossing comparators for sensorless rotor position detection. Also, there is only one signal that is processed – this reduces the requirements for number of multiplexed ADC inputs. The proposed control algorithm could be used with PWM regulation; the operational speed range is limited only by ADC accuracy parameters. The main feature of the proposed control method is that it allows to implement multiple BLDCs controller using a single microcontroller having built-in ADC and timers with PWM capability, with relatively low usage of its processing power. In the article, a description of the proposed algorithm is presented. The theoretical results were experimentally verified and proven, the description of an experimental setup is given. The proposed approach to BLDC control may find its use in development of drones with custom aerodynamic and control system by enabling high degree of integration of processing functions in one microcontroller, thus reducing the system BOM cost.

articleTitle: Modeling of Solar Cells with Quantum Dots GaN
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Mathematical computer modeling of the electron state in a quantum dot GaN with a shell is considered in order to use the study results to optimize the parameters of third generation of solar panels. The dependence study of the spectrum of natural energy levels on the parameters of cylindrical, prismatic and pyramidal quantum dots with a shell is presented in this article. To calculate the optimal size of quantum dots, a finite motion model of quasi-free S-electrons with the corresponding effective mass is used. The Schrödinger wave equation for steady states and boundary conditions at the core-shell boundary of quantum dots are applied. Scilab software package, numerical methods and discrete structured grids are used for mathematical modeling and plotting the probability density of an electron in a given region of a prismatic quantum dot. The technology of obtaining arrays quantum dots GaN of porous GaAs is proposed and optimized. The relevance and prospects of quantum dots application in modern solar panels are considered, namely the possibility of using GaN/porous-GaAs/GaAs heterostructures as photoelectric converters of solar energy. The proposed structures of solar cells can increase the efficiency of conversion of solar energy, which can double the existing efficiency of solar panels.

Author Keywords: Fourier method of separation of variables

articleTitle: The Electric Power Quantities Correlation Degree Estimation on Substation Transformer Secondary Voltage Buses an Industrial Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Electricity has a uses wide range and the electricity consumption level is growing every year. At the same time in networks there is a loading change, unbalance and increase in harmonic distortions level under use conditions loadings with nonlinear characteristics that complicates control over electric power quality. To control the change in quality, it is necessary to monitor a significant power quantities number, which leads to an increase in the information amount and the need to use generalized time measurement values parameters. In this task, it is useful to use statistical information processing methods. The paper uses one of the statistical methods that is widely used in power engineering - correlation analysis. Correlation is used to establish a relationship between electric power quantities. The analysis was performed on the components of total, active and reactive power obtained during the monitoring of the industrial enterprise main lowering substation. Additionally, current and voltage distortion powers are determined according to the IEEE 1459-2010 standard. For the study object presented in the work, there is a significant relationship between full and active power, which may indicate the reactive power level compensation over time. According to the daily mode, the power distortion components have a relatively low degree their correlation with the reactive power (0.3-0.7), in contrast to the active power (0.7-0.9). The results of the work can be used in the construction of systems for monitoring electricity flows.

articleTitle: dComFra Project Learning Module M20 "Advanced Spreadsheets" in Mathematical Modeling Tasks of Electrical and Computer Engineers Education
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The necessity of wide application of mathematical modeling in the electrical engineers’ education is stated. It is shown that a simple and affordable mean of modeling electrical networks, alternative to specialized software packages, is the MS Excel spreadsheet processor. The abilities of the processor at the example of some optimization problems solution in electrical networks are shown.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Power Supply with Variable Speed Drive for Automatically Move Irrigation Equipment: Margin of Feasibility
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Center pivot irrigation systems are widely used in agriculture. Their water pumping systems are primary energy consumers. The use of photovoltaic power plants and variable speed drives of electric motors can reduce energy costs. The purpose of this study is to determine the feasibility of integrating variable speed drives and photovoltaic modules into water pumping systems. A novel architecture of a pumping system was suggested. Its features are no battery backup and the sale of electricity into the grid.

articleTitle: System Designed to Collect and Process Human Reaction Time Data
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: This paper deals with the creation of a test system for testing human reaction time. It deals with the reaction time and various internal and external factors that affect it. Test system consists of a prototype for determining the test conditions (external factors) and an established application designed for testing the reaction time and evaluating the test results. It describes the technical security used in the design and manufacture of the laboratory model. It describes the graphical environment of the application, the method of testing the reaction time, evaluation, processing of results and its other functions.

articleTitle: Research of Closed Loop Control Systems of the Electric Drive of Mine Electric Locomotive with the DC Series Motor and Nonlinear Load
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The results of studies of open-loop system and closed-loop control systems for the electric drive of mine electric locomotive ARP14 with the direct-current series motors are presented. The analysis of quality indicators of systems built by algorithms of the system of subordinate control, modal control with and without state observer, and on the basis of multilayer neural network is done. The advantages of the perceptron neural network synthesized by a genetic algorithm as a teaching procedure are shown.

Author Keywords: the electric drive of mine electric locomotive with the DC series motor

articleTitle: Pedagogical Technology of Management of Students’ Educational and Creative Activities in the Process of Professional Training of Engineers
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The purpose of the article was to analyze modern didactic approaches to improvement the training of future engineers by means of pedagogical technologies. The process of formation of professional and creative competence of future engineers on the basis of introduction of pedagogical technology of management of students’ educational and creative activities was substantiated. It was proved that the pedagogical technology of management of educational and creative activity of students was based on introduction of administrative functions in the educational environment in the conditions of a high level of technologicalization of educational process. The results of the pedagogical experiment confirmed the increase of creative activity of students majoring in «Agroengineering", stimulating their independence, individualization and cognitive-exploratory activities, which had a positive effect on the formation of professional and creative competence of the future engineer.

articleTitle: Trajectories of Student’s Personal Development and Learning During Pandemic Covid-19
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The article describes the changes that took place in education during the COVID-19 pandemic. In this context the student's personal and behavioral changes were examined. It was found that they are characterized by ambiguous life orientations, reduced readiness to life changes, strengthening of avoidant coping strategies and the reduction of social resources in resolving problems. This suggests the change in principles of pedagogical activity and educational space: variability, mutual complementarity of different educational forms; creation of conditions for individual educational trajectories and generation of their novel meanings; distributed and mutual students-teacher participation in the mass production of personified knowledge which is a gig-education.

articleTitle: Modeling of Power Supply for Welding with Power Factor Correction
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: In the article, the options for increasing of the energy efficiency of the resonant welding power supply are analysed. A topology with passive power factor correction by an application of the Valley-Fill type input rectifier is considered. The welding power supply is based on a resonant LLC converter with parameters specially adopted to allow it to be used as a welding power supply, where an electric arc acts as a load. The welding arc in steady state operation is modeled as a resistive load. As a result of the simulation, a decrease of total harmonic distortion (THD) of the input current was confirmed by more than 2 times compared with the use of a conventional diode bridge rectifier, while providing the output voltage and current required for the welding process.

articleTitle: Experimental Study of the Influence of the Inner Filling of a Brick on the Penetration of Electromagnetic Field
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: This paper deals with measuring the shielding and reflection efficiency of the electromagnetic field. The measured objects were two building materials - a classic brick with air gaps and a brick filled with mineral wool. The experiment was aimed at comparing the shielding and reflection efficiencies of these two materials. From the results of measuring the shielding and reflection efficiency, it is possible to calculate the absorption of the electromagnetic field. Experiment was performed according Standard IEEE 299-2006 Standard: Method for Measuring the Effectiveness of Electromagnetic Shielding Enclosures.

articleTitle: Expression for Calculation of Lightning Ground Flash Density for Conditions of India
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The ground flash density is the number of lightning strikes to ground per square kilometer per year. If no measurements of the ground flash density for specific area are available, this parameter can be roughly estimated from the annual number of thunderstorm days with a help of several well-known expressions. Indian standard IS 2309 indicates the relationship between thunderstorm days per year and lightning flashes per square kilometer per year for several thunderstorm day values. According to Indian standard IS 2309, the Indian annual thunderstorm days count is ranging from 1 to 103. Approximation of ground flash density based on standard data was made, allowing calculation of cloud-to-ground lightning flash density in the whole range of thunderstorm days for conditions of India. The resulting expression more closely matches the data of the standard than other known expressions.

articleTitle: Electroceutical Tools in Diagnostics and Therapy of COVID-19
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Fighting against the SARS-CoV-2 virus and its consequence COVID-19 was the main task for scientists in the years 2020-2021. The authors of this article present innovative solutions which recently were undertaken by electrical and computer engineers to participate in the struggle with the pandemic of COVID-19 in the world. The number of the attempts presented is limited as well as a pretty big number of them are still in progress. The paper shows the representative solutions which can be used in the pandemic of COVID-19 or in any other pandemic in the future as the temperature monitoring, ansomia and cough analysis, vaccines using the electroporation phenomena.

articleTitle: Research of the Machining Center Electromechanical Drive with Technological Feedback
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Simulation of the electromechanical drive dynamics for the main motion of a multioperational machine according to the criterion of vibration resistance, taking into account technological feedback, is implemented. Calculations of the kinematic and energy parameters of the electric drives of 4PF series engine in the entire range of the rotation frequency have been carried out. A block diagram of the static process of milling is constructed, reflecting the relationship of control actions with output parameters. The frequency characteristics analysis of the machine tool system as a set of the main forming units: the spindle-tool unit, the rotary-workpiece and the cutting process in the Signal Processing environment is carried out. The optimal values of the cutting mode, which form the output parameter of the cutting force, as a checking control action are found. The region of stability for the system of cutting power stabilization and the influence on it of variations in the parameters of the cutting process using the method of D-partitions are determined. An experimental study of two options for technological adjustments of the milling operation, which differ in the length of the tool block overhang, were carried out. The optimal values of the processing mode are found with the help of the D-partition boundary in the plane of the cutting coefficient, which ensure the stability of a multioperational machine drive operation.

articleTitle: Optimization of the Positional Control System for Electrical Drives of Non-Supported Pendulum Suspended Ropeways
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Based on the studies of dynamic processes taking place in the electromechanical part of electrical drives of non-supported pendulum suspended ropeway in start-up and braking modes, it was proved that the dynamic processes taking place in the movable mechanical part are due to the tachogram of the movement of the electrical drive, which in turn does not fully reflect the dynamic processes taking place in the movable mechanical part of the electrical drive. That is, it does not take into account the acceleration of suspended cabins due to the weight of running trolleys and external cabins, since in start-up and braking modes the structure of the initial design model of the mobile mechanical part of the electrical drive changes twice, with two-mass with split driven masses it passes three-mass and back. On the basis of the conducted study of the dynamic processes taking place in the movable mechanical part of the electrical drive non-supported pendulum suspended ropeway in start-up and braking modes, the methodology for compiling the optimal tachogram of electrical drive movement according to high dynamic indicators and productivity, taking into account all the features of the kinematic scheme of the non-supported pendulum suspended ropeway, is justified. The calculation method its parameters are given. Application of tachogram of motion in control systems of electrical drive of non-supported pendulum suspended ropeway built by the proposed method excludes changes in structure of design model of the movable mechanical part of the electrical drives in transient modes, which leads to improvement of dynamic parameters of electrical drive and accuracy of control of movement of suspended cabins of pendulum suspended ropeway.

articleTitle: Competence and Resource-Oriented Approaches to the Development of Digital Educational Resources
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The article analyzes and highlights the implementation mechanisms of competence and resource-oriented approaches to the development of digital educational resources for the successful formation of digital competence of future bachelors in power engineering, electrical engineering, and electromechanics. It has been established that the competence approach to the development of digital educational resources for the formation of digital competence of future bachelors in power engineering, electrical engineering, and electromechanics leads to the improvement of the structure of digital educational resources. Ways of improvement are defined by a technological link: formulation of the purpose – ways of formation of digital competence – selection of the maintenance of training material. It is revealed that the resource-oriented approach to the development of digital educational resources for the formation of digital competence of future bachelors in electric power, electrical engineering, and electromechanics is focused on the concept of resource-oriented learning in higher education. It provides for the creation of a set of different types of digital educational resources in order to further their implementation in the educational process, encouraging teachers to improve the content of these digital educational resources) in combination with software applications and digital technologies. It is concluded that the integrated development of different types of digital educational resources taking into account competency and resource-oriented approaches improves the process of digital competence of future bachelors in electric power, electrical engineering, and electromechanics in distance learning based on the principles of flexibility, complexity, integration, dynamism, and openness.

articleTitle: Analysis of Vibroreological Indicators in the Formation of the Moment of Control of the Electric Drive in Special Modes
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: During the movement of technological mechanisms under load, the electric drive must form a moment that would ensure a trouble-free mode of operation of both the technological mechanism and the electric drive. Modern research in vibroreology suggests that the destruction of intermolecular forces in the working environment during the application of vibration, which is manifested in the relative motion of the layers of the structured environment, leads to the destruction of bonds in the structure, reducing friction and adhesion, yield strength . This creates the conditions for the manifestation of current at lower shear stresses. During the analysis of physicochemical processes occurring in the working body with the working environment during downtime, it was found that for the complete destruction of the structure requires anisotropic regime of variable frequency and moment of vibration. The reduction of plastic viscosity in this case is achieved by destroying the structure of the medium.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence as a Key Driver of Business Operations Transformation in the Conditions of the Digital Economy
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: In the modern conditions of the Fourth Industrial Revolution, while digital transformations are affecting the economy, an unique opportunity to transform business operations as well as to increase productivity significantly and create new products appears. The paper deals with the essence of Artificial Intelligence and Digital Transformation as an economic categories and the fastest growing technological segments in the global information environment. Thus, the aim of the paper is to study prediction algorithms as a unique opportunity to transform business operations by the use of digital technologies and the revitalization of e-commerce. The emphasis is on the fact that most enterprises are in the early stages of digitalization, which presents certain risks and opportunities. The authors consider that the artificial intelligence has already become an important factor of production to create sustainable economic growth and ensure the competitive advantage of any business organization.

articleTitle: Introduction of Energy Efficient Technologies of Amalgamated Territorial Communities as a Basis of Energy Independence
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The article examines the theoretical, methodological and analytical provisions for the introduction of energy efficient technologies in amalgamated territorial communities. The synthesis of research results allows to identify key characteristics that contain the main approaches and recommendations for creating a system of energy management at the community level. In addition, the authors note that the main objectives of the energy management system at the level of amalgamated territorial communities is to maintain energy costs in the budget sphere at the lowest possible (taking into account the existing technical condition) while maintaining the conditions of visitors and staff at the level corresponding to existing regulatory documents; preparation and implementation of technical and organizational measures to reduce budget expenditures on energy and improve the living conditions of visitors and staff; introduction of a system of stimulating the economical use of energy resources at all levels of amalgamated territorial communities management.

articleTitle: Providing the Competitiveness of Education due to the Formation of Professional Competence via the Project-Based Learning Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper highlights the innovative approach to providing the competitiveness of education. The idea of the productivity of project-based learning on the basis of integrative disciplines as a holistic reflection of the unity of professional and humanities knowledge in the scientific picture is presented. Academic disciplines are the integration of basic sciences at the applied level. Mathematical formalization, due to the high degree of generality of its apparatus, is recognized as the leading means of forming integrative content of educational competitiveness. The need for a new type of rationality is substantiated, which will provide the coordination of logic with the purpose of human existence and is able to combine rational and irrational forms of comprehension of reality and expand the scope of mathematical formalization. It is claimed that the decisive role in making a project decision belongs to the subject. A comparison of traditional and project-based learning according to the main criteria and practical advice on the areas of project implementation are presented.

articleTitle: Implementation of Marketing Tools in the Developvment of Industry 4.0
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Article provides the advantages of using marketing tools for the modern enterprise in the conditions of Industry 4.0. The features and business opportunities of the most popular social networks in Ukraine are described. An empirical survey of users of the networks assessed was conducted, which revealed the factors and motives for making a purchase via the Internet. The importance of quality components of service in social networks is estimated. A mechanism for selling via social networks based on viral marketing is introduced. A viral marketing toolkit is proposed to increase the business page users.

articleTitle: Social and Psychological Readiness of Electrical Engineering Students for Academic Mobility
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper summarizes the concept of academic mobility, considers the essence of social and psychological readiness of electrical engineering students for academic mobility and prove the need for its development. Motivational, cognitive, communicative components and the component of personal activity in the structure of socio-psychological readiness of electrical engineering students for academic mobility are characterized. The results of self-appraisal of socio-psychological readiness of electrical engineering students for academic mobility are presented. Educational conditions, which ensure the formation of all components of socio-psychological readiness of future electrical engineers for academic mobility in the educational process are determined.

articleTitle: The Method of Operations Models Forming under Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The aim of the work is to develop a method of operations models forming by introducing restrictions on the operation parameters of the compared operational processes. Consequently, we need to formulate rules for determining of tolerance region of cost estimates for the output product of operational process consisted of short operations. Also, we need to develop the method of tolerance region determining for the parameters of short operations for compared processes. This allows to us formalize the solution of the constraints determining problem for the generated model data. Also we need to carry out test experiments of the developed method on the example of the estimated factors designed to effectiveness determining. The developed modeling method was verified by comparing the results of two operational processes. A comparison of the operational processes results with evaluating of the individual operations results of these processes is obtained. The discrepancy between the simulation results and the results of direct assessment of operations using verified indicators in the area excluded from consideration, using the developed method is observed. The developed modeling method allows to us determine the restrictions area of the simulated operations parameters. Under the conditions of this area accounting, the errors probability in modeling results of problems associated with decision making is eliminated.

articleTitle: Creating an Enabling Environment for the Sponsored Research in the Case of Institute of Electrical Engineering and Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper presents the results of participating in the IREX University Administration Support Program. An implementation plan for the "Establishing Development Program for Sponsored Research at Kremenchuk Mykhailo Ostrohradskyi National University" based on SWOT analysis is proposed. The expected outputs and outcomes of the project were analyzed. To understand the value of all participants involved in the project implementation plan, an analysis of stakeholders (internal departments of the university) was carried out. The work plan of the step-by-step execution of the project using the Gantt chart is presented. The new approach to the providing support of sponsored research was suggested. The first results of the project implementation for academic staff of the Institute of electrical engineering and information technology of the Kremenchuk Mykhailo Ostrohradskyi National University are shown.

articleTitle: Implementation of Tutorials with Interactive Elements for the Study of General Technical and Electrical Engineering Disciplines in the E-environment
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The article presents the technology of implementation of tutorials with interactive elements for the study of general technical and electrical engineering disciplines in the e-environment. The levels of study of these disciplines are described. The types of interactive audiovisual online tools according to the types of classes are presented: lectures, laboratory and practical works and independent tasks. At the initial level, it is proposed to use multimedia online lectures, video instructions for practical and laboratory work in general technical and electrical engineering disciplines, test simulators. Audiovisual lectures, online calculators for practical works, online laboratory works, graphic training simulators are used at a sufficient level. The average level involves the use of interactive lectures, video tutorials for studying engineering programs, online laboratory work with the presentation of results in an e-environment, gamified training simulators. At a high level it is proposed to use interactive lectures with a task for reflection, an engineering project in general technical and electrical engineering disciplines in an e-environment, online laboratory work with discussion in a thematic forum, report on a webinar with the presentation of engineering developments. Tutorials for future electrical engineers in general technical disciplines "Mechanics of Materials and Constructions", "Theory of Mechanisms and Machines", "Engineering and Computer Graphics" and electrical engineering disciplines "Theoretical Foundations of Electrical Engineering", "Electrical Technologies" for studying in the e-environment were created and tested. Such tutorials contain interactive audiovisual online tools for performing tasks in an e-environment that are presented with the help of QR-codes. The obtained results were checked according to the Kolmogorov-Smirnov criterion.

articleTitle: Modern Aspects of Regional Energy Clusters Innovative Development
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper presents the results of the study of the process of the integrated vision concept formation and system support of regional development reform based on the extension of the future energy-efficient development cluster or cluster-innovative model of Ukraine’s regions. It is proved that the energy cluster policy concept development and implementation should be recognized as a real tool for further regional innovation-oriented energy efficiency policy formation with a task group format, feasible and sequential actions, resources and human capital engagement, potential opportunities for its accumulation. As a result, in the realm of the national economy of Ukraine, the formation of future cluster model of Ukraine's economy should be expected with its specific characteristics, development prospects, the advanced approaches to cluster formation.

articleTitle: Psychological and Educational Conditions for Developing Intellectual Competence of Electrical Engineering Students
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The article analyses some psychological and educational conditions for the development of intellectual competence in the process of electrical engineers training. It was substantiated that intellectually developing education is an effective way of improving intellectual competence of students while the training at the university. It is intended to be the means of student improvement and to promote self-education and self-realization of future specialists. For effective development of intellectual competence, it’s necessary to intensify developmental potential of all the components of the educational process including the training content, organizational forms and teaching methods as well. It was discovered that indispensable psychological and educational conditions providing the most effective development of intellectual competence of future electrical engineers are modelling of intellectual and developing situations; involving students in various types of research activities related to the improvement and enrichment of personal invariant intellectual structures; development of psychological and educational support for the training process of future specialists, which implements stimulating, developmental, diagnostic, and correctional functions.

articleTitle: Structural Model of Training Bachelors in Electrical Engineering in the Online Learning Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The article presents the structural model of training Bachelors in Electrical Engineering in the online environment of higher education institution. It is determined that the outlined model consists of the five blocks. The target block is characterized by the definition of modern leading ideas for the training of Bachelors in specialty ‘Electric Power, Electrical Engineering and Electrical Mechanics’. The conceptual block takes into account the methodological approaches and tasks of training Bachelors in the online learning environment. The content block describes the content of education at each level. The technological block includes forms, means and technologies of training. The result block provides monitoring of professional training of Bachelors in Electrical Engineering, which is carried out on the basis of certain criteria: motivational, operational, integration, creative. All this can be done at the initial, intermediate, sufficient or high levels. The structural model provides an opportunity to combine the full-time educational process with learning in the online learning environment, forms analytical skills and competencies in professional activities. The reliability of the obtained results was checked using the Kolmogorov-Smirnov criterion.

articleTitle: Stability Testing of Control Algorithms for Active Magnetic Bearings to Measurement Errors Occurrence on Scale Model of Turbocompressor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper considers active magnetic bearings of turbomachines rotating rotors from the point of view of their control algorithms stability to the occurrence of state parameters measurement errors. The fact of rotor stabilization in the central position relative to the active magnetic bearing stators was taken as the performance criterion, ensuring the stability of its motion when disturbing influences are introduced. The considered above state parameters include displacements and speeds of the rotor support sections, as well as currents in the windings of power electromagnets in active magnetic bearings. The research was carried out for experimental model of centrifugal compressor of gas-pumping unit for main gas pipelines. This model is the copy of compressor with active magnetic bearings in sale. The algorithm for analog or discrete control system with pulse mode operation was selected to implement the methodology of stability assessment of active magnetic bearing control algorithms to the accuracy of state parameters measuring. It is based on an arc-loaded graph. Its distinctive feature is the simplicity of implementation due to the use of only logical operations, taking into account a large number of control parameters from the current rotor position to instantaneous currents in the active magnetic bearing windings and the possibility of adaptive tuning with the inclusion of optimization procedures. The ranges of algorithm stability to the state parameters measurement errors due to various factors are determined for this system, using simulation. The results are experimentally confirmed. The proposed method for the imitation analysis of processes in active magnetic bearings to assess the quality of their control systems can be used to test various algorithms for discrete or analog control for resistance to errors in circuits measuring.

articleTitle: Visualisation of the Maturity of Future Electrical Engineers Professional Competencies
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: the article considers the actual problem of pedagogical diagnostics of the professional competencies’ maturity on the example of students of engineering specialties. The initial data were obtained as a result of experimental studies while which various diagnostic tools for the assessment of students training quality were used. The authors have suggested a method for the diagnostics of professional competencies which is based on the principle of tasks being differentiated in accordance with the defined competencies, and which allows us to obtain more reliable information about the level of their maturity. Also, there have been presented the code fragments of the developed modelling software aimed at the creation of a visual image being the result of the competencies diagnostics.

Author Keywords: training of specialists in electrical engineering
visualisation of professional competencies maturity level

articleTitle: Research of Electric Contact Welding by a Wire at Restoration of Details of Cars
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The article presents the results of a study of electrical contact welding with a wire when restoring the working surface of machine parts.In order to test the effectiveness of the developed measures to prevent interlayer fractures, the samples after multilayer welding and rough grinding were subjected to embossing with an impact energy of 6 J. The thickness of the layer after rough grinding was 1.5 mm. The depth of hardening, determined by measurements of microhardness, was 3.5 … 4 mm. Metallographic studies of interlayer fractures of the multilayer coating did not reveal. It was found that the cause of continuity defects in the "scallops" of the welded metal layer is the increased current density in the cross section of the upset wire from the side of the previously welded roller. This leads to local overheating of a part of the filler metal, its squeezing out from under the electrode and cooling on the surface of the previously welded bead in the absence of forging. An increase in the width of the working part of the roller electrode over a certain value, depending on the diameter of the filler wire, the amount of its upsetting, the welding step, prevents the upsetting wire from being squeezed out from under the electrode and eliminates the reasons for the formation of these defects. An increase in the torque of the roller electrode leads to an increase in the strength of the formed welded joint due to an increase in the relative axial deformation of the filler wire. It was found that an increase in the relative axial deformation of the filler wire leads to a slowdown in the rotation of the roller electrode.
