This makes it possible to control the relative axial deformation of the filler wire directly during the welding process by counting the number of revolutions of the roller electrode and the part.

articleTitle: Methods for Organising Conferences for Electrical Engineering Specialists via Distance Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The article describes the developed method for organizing scientific conferences for educating electrical engineering specialists via distance learning. The method involves six stages: outlining the theme of the conference in the frame of the studied discipline and taking into account professional features; discussing abstract theses of reports; preparing abstract reports; preparing electronic tools for the implementation of a scientific conference; preparing future specialists in electrical engineering to speak online and preparing them for discussions in the context of their own report, taking into account the specifics of the specialty. It is determined that for the organization and holding the conference via distance learning for educating specialists in electrical engineering it is necessary carefully to prepare the topic and directions of the conference, as well as to create sections in accordance with scientific directions. It was emphasized that the theme of such an event should be modern and interesting for students, should include the latest technologies of electrical engineering and tools in the field of power engineering. It is substantiated that theses should reflect the materials of own or co-authored research. It is noted that the text of theses should contain the relevance of the problem, the scientific novelty, the purpose, methods and results of a research, as well as conclusions. The offered technique of the organization of scientific conferences for educating specifics in electric engineering via distance learning was tested in the Mykolayiv National Agrarian University. The results obtained before and after the experiment were verified using the statistical λ by the Kolmogorov-Smirnov criterion. It is proved that this author's method of educating specialists in electrical engineering via distance learning is promising.

articleTitle: Energy Management of Hybrid Three-Phase Photoelectric System with Storage Battery to Meet the Needs of Local Object
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Improving the energy management of three-phase photoelectric system with storage battery to meet the needs of local object without generation into grid is presented. The aim is reducing the cost of paying for electricity consumed from the grid. The expediency of the autonomous functioning of the system when the energy of the photovoltaic and storage batteries is sufficient for the consumption of the object is shown. Connection to the grid is carried out when the energy is insufficient. This eliminates the influence of possible violations of the quality of the grid voltage and, when regulating the voltage (power) of the load, creates additional possibilities for controlling the storage battery charge. The principles of prediction the degree of storage battery charge when controlling the switching of operating modes in accordance with the forecast of the generation of a photovoltaic battery have been developed. This reduces the consumption of power from the grid to charge the storage battery during night and daytime while providing sufficient charge for the object functioning during peak hours. It is shown that when using two photovoltaic batteries, generation control can be carried out only for one of them, with the other disconnected when the load decreases and the storage battery charge is more than 80%. The corresponding algorithms and structure of the control system for the implementation of the proposed solutions were developed. The results of simulation of energy processes in a daily mode confirm the efficiency of the proposed solutions and the possibility of reducing the cost of paying for energy consumed from the grid from 1.4 to 6 times with two and three-zone tariffication.

Author Keywords: energy management of the hybrid photoelectric system
predictive control of storage battery charge
the cost of paying for consumed electricity

articleTitle: The Variant Analysis of the Local Heat Release in the Rotor of a Synchronous Machine Under Short-Term Operating Conditions
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Variant calculation research revealed the main regularities of the distribution of heat release along the radial and tangential coordinates at the pole division in the active zone of solid gear rotors when starting synchronous machines of various designs. The changes in the values of local specific heat releases in the elements of the surface layer of characteristic cog divisions and, in general, in individual structural areas of the rotors in the slip function are analyzed. Based on numerical modeling, an assessment of design measures aimed at reducing local thermal loads in the rotor elements during asynchronous start of electric motors of compressor stations of main gas pipelines is carried out.

articleTitle: Digitalization of Education: An Urgent Need of Sustainable Teaching Process Caused by Covid 19
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The study aims to identify the benefits and problematic aspects of applying e-learning technologies at Ukrainian universities, taking into account several influential factors, such as technical capabilities, the necessary skills of students and tutors, etc. Using e-learning has several advantages, such as more convenience, greater accessibility, the possibility of an individual approach, and better demonstration opportunities. The article discusses specific tools for educational digitalization, using which should increase the effectiveness and availability of training in COVID 19 pandemic conditions.

articleTitle: Recognition of High-Temperature Overheating in High-Voltage Power Transformers by Dissolved Gas Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The results of gas content analysis for 575 high-voltage power transformers with high-temperature overheating are presented. The values of diagnostic criteria used to recognize the type of defect based on the analysis of dissolved gases in oil have been analysed. It was found that the ethylene percentage in the oil of transformers with high-temperature overheating can be described by the Weibull distribution. At the same time a shift of mathematical expectations of ethylene percentage content to the area of higher values is observed as temperature of hot spot increases. It is shown that in spite of differences in gas percentages, values of characteristic gas ratios correspond to overheating with temperatures above 700°C. Based on the analysis of gas content dynamics in time during defect development, the most characteristic features are revealed, the use of which allows to detect such defects at an early stage that is before the gas concentrations exceed their limit values. A comparative analysis of the reliability of recognition of high-temperature overheating using the best known standards and techniques for the interpretation of DGA results has been carried out.

articleTitle: Adjustment of Biogas Production Parameters Using Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper proposes the use of a neural network to regulate the parameters of methanogenesis process of blue-green algae biomass.

articleTitle: Permanent Magnets with Magnetizing Winding for Varying Mechanical Stiffness
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper considers passive magnetic bearings for small and medium-sized rotating rotors. It proposes several schemes of a magnetic support made using two permanent annular magnets with the axial magnetization. A distinctive feature of these magnetic bearing schemes is the possibility of short-term changes in the stiffness parameters. This is achieved through the use of bias windings. The technique and results of computational studies to determine the dependencies of the restoring magnetic forces and stiffnesses on the displacement of the rotor in the radial direction are presented. The validation of the calculation results was carried out according to the experimental data for an option of a controlled radial passive magnetic bearing used in a test rig. This rig implements a full rotor magnetic suspension, includes two radial passive magnetic bearings and one axial active magnetic bearing and is a prototype for small and medium-sized turbomachines. The paper also presents a comparative analysis of various design schemes of passive magnetic bearings with controlled stiffness.

articleTitle: Databases Case Study in Substantiation of Reconstruction of Power Distribution Networks Objects
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Examples of the use of databases (that are used for reporting forms, and that you can form according to the calculation results and according to reference database) in the automated enterprise management system of the power distribution system for feasibility study of distribution network objects reconstruction are proposed. The diagram of the databases recommended for use for calculations of technical indicators in the substantiation of reconstruction of power distribution networks objects is developed. The flowchart of the algorithm for calculating technological electricity losses and voltage losses when using existing databases and with the formation of a database of calculation results, the flowchart of an income calculations example for economic substantiation of the reconstruction of the overhead transmission line based on the use of data from the previous year offered for use.

articleTitle: Diagnosing the Condition of Transformer Oils Using the Trajectory Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper describes a method for early diagnosis of the condition of transformer oils, based on the use of indicator trajectories. Based on the statistical analysis of the periodic test results for 121 transformers of 110 kV voltage, 6 reference trajectories of transformer oils color have been formed. To form the reference trajectories, in the conditions of the partial lack of information about the transformer loading factors, the criterion of the maximum correlation ratio has been proposed, which allowed to take into account the nonlinear nature of the oil color dependences on the duration of operation. An algorithm for recognizing the state of transformer oils, taking into account the differences in operating conditions of transformers has been proposed. The given examples of practical use of the method showed its high efficiency not only in the recognition of normal and abnormal aging of oils, but also for the detection of violations in the process of sampling, transportation of oil samples and performing analysis.

articleTitle: Teaching Electrical Engineering Students the Skill of Academic Essay Writing in the Context of Scientific Discourse
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The article considers the academic essay as the main simulator in teaching students of electrical engineering specialties academic writing. The importance of such skill in academic writing for students in view of international requirements and standards is emphasized. The place of academic essay in scientific discourse, features of its structure and text organization are determined. Particular attention is paid to the importance of task response criterion and consistent development of argumentation. The most common mistakes in writing an academic essay, both structural and logical errors, are analyzed.

articleTitle: Principles of Construction and Operation of Fuzzy Models of Reliability of Structural Units of Electric Machines
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Approaches to building models of reliability of structural units of electric machines in the presence and development of their main types of defects have been developed. The principles of formation of membership functions are conditioned, features of change of indicators of reliability at transitions between various constructive states in functions of change of the basic informative parameters are defined. The developed approaches and principles are tested on the basis of a number of structural units of induction motors.

articleTitle: Fault Area Location in Electrical Distribution System Using Smart Meter Data
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Power distribution systems are becoming increasingly digitalized. This provides a lot of potential for data-driven protection, automation, and maintenance methods. However, large-scale integrated hardware and software solutions can be difficult to manage, so maintenance methods that use data that are already collected are of high value. The contribution of this paper is to propose a new method for fault area location in power distribution systems. The method uses a technique for multivariate process monitoring based on principal component analysis, which employs both fault detection and diagnosis. It uses only aggregated smart meter data, which is normally collected for billing purposes, and improves the features using feature engineering. The output of the method is a list of component labels, which is ordered according to which components are most likely to be affected by an interruption. The method is tested on data from a real Danish power distribution system and can precisely identify, medium-voltage transformers and low-voltage radials that are affected by an interruption and gives good indications of which electrical boxes are affected. The method integrates with a GIS system to provide coordinates of affected components and, importantly, gives no false positives fault detections.

articleTitle: Optimization of LMS Moodle configuration and Education Technologies on the Example of Electrical Engineering Education
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The analysis of the typical configuration of LMS Moodle is performed. The classification of plugins and system processes according to the criterion of competitive load on the system is given on the basis of statistical data collected on the example of training courses of electrotechnical specialties of KrNU. Based on the experience of LMS Moodle implementing, recommendations are given to administrators, lecturers and department heads to optimize the load on the Moodle system. It is investigated that such recommendations allow to reduce the peak load of the system by 15-20% in average.

articleTitle: To the Issue of the of Copper-Aluminum Elements Production for Conductive Assemblies in Electrometallurgy
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Recently, copper-aluminum elements of various current-carrying units have been widely used in electrometallurgy. Their manufacture is most often carried out using explosion welding, one of the main technological parameters of which is the explosive detonation rate. One of the most common explosives for explosion welding is a ammonite mixture with various inert additives. In this work, for the first time, the main attention is paid to the study the adding gas-forming substance to the explosive charge effect on its detonation velocity. It was established for the first time that the solid propellant presence in the 6 ZhV ammonite charge makes it possible to reduce the detonation velocity by almost 30% and to increase the propelling ability in the mixed charge by 10%.

articleTitle: E-Learning Course Design Concept for Engineering Students on the Basis of Competence Approach
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: In the current pandemic situation distance learning has become the most important for learning and knowledge was the only possible way of education during the quarantine. The issue of distance learning implementing for the engineering specialties students which during their training, must acquire applied (professional, special) competencies, be able to perform the relevant types of professional activity is particularly important for now. These students mainly acquire competencies aimed at solving subject-mental and symbolic-practical problems. To develop an effective online course (OC), the research results presented in the article obtained on the basis of the use of such general scientific tools as a hypothetical-deductive method and bases of the activity-based approach in the understanding of competencies and the learning process. The article considers developing an online course in a fundamental professional academic course based on a competency-based approach. In order to test the concept (hypotheses) provisions the online course on fundamental professional academic course (FPAC) was developed.

articleTitle: Use of Modern Educational Technologies in the Electrical Engineers and Electromechanics Preparation by a Blended Learning System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: An integrated approach to the introduction of the latest educational technologies with the use of interactive forms of education in the electrical engineers and electromechanics preparation in a blended learning system is proposed. It has been proven that the use of simulation and game modeling, virtual laboratory workshops, case technologies in the study of the training course «Power Plants» will help to form professional competencies, help to understand the main directions and patterns of electrical energy at various types of power plants and help to understand ways to save fuel and energy resources, methods and ways of solving topical issues of energy supply in energy systems. An example of the use of methodological and software ensuring, pedagogical techniques and tools that will allow performing all types of load in the study of professional discipline by future specialists in the field of electrical engineering, electric power engineering and electromechanics is given. The research results can be used in the educational process in the formation of information and professional competencies of specialists in the field of electrical engineering, electric power engineering and electromechanics.

articleTitle: The Methodology for Assessment of Engineering Students Outcomes
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper presents the methodology for assessment of engineering students outcomes. The research was focused on the evaluating for the purpose of development and improvement of engineering students’ competence achievements during their professional training. The assessment procedure was based on the comparison of the real students learning outcomes with the etalon ones. An assessment process, which included four stages, was designed. All the stages were divided into phases. That enabled to define a real level of engineering students competence. The proposed assessment method was based on the idea to differentiate the professional activities. That provided educators with the scientific basis for the purposeful development of diagnostic tools, performance of technological diagnostic procedures and obtaining objective, reliable results which show the engineering students learning outcomes.

articleTitle: Personal Effectiveness and the Innovative Decision-Making Skills on Electrical Engineering Education
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The article considers the peculiarities of acquiring the personal effectiveness and innovative decision-making skills on electrical engineering education. Studies have confirmed that, in addition to limited resources, innovation management is complicated by the level of training of specialists, which affects the level of necessary knowledge required in making and implementing management decisions. This is especially important in the context of Industry 4.0 progress. Insufficient level of mastery of methodological tools for assessing the effectiveness of innovation, lack of willingness to take innovation risks are often the reasons that prevent companies from implementing both product and process innovations. In order to acquire the necessary competencies in the training of specialists, it is advisable to pay attention to the need to teach disciplines related to the development of personal initiative, ensuring personal effectiveness and efficiency.

articleTitle: Boundary Surface Visualization of MVL Memory: from 2D to 3D
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The article presents for the first time a gallery of 3D boundary surfaces of a multi-value memory cell. In the analysis, we chose such sizes of parasitic elements on the chip, in which there are no stable limit cycles present in the memory, assuming that the absence of stable limit cycles will greatly simplify the transcription of information in the memory. However, this fact was not confirmed and the 3D gallery of boundary surfaces points to the need to know the boundary surface for each case of changing the size of parasitic capacitances on the chip. This will make it possible to explain the memory failure associated with, for example, a change in technology in the memory production. At the same time, visualization of boundary surfaces, attractors or chaotic attractors using virtual reality technologies is offered for another technical activities.

articleTitle: A Method for the Assessment of Power Controllability of an Electrohydraulic Complex
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: It is demonstrated that the electrohydraulic complex is a complex system of interconnected electromechanical and hydraulic equipment with low controllability of parameters in non-stationary modes. The estimation of controllability in the electrohydraulic complex should be based on the analysis of energy conversion processes in all links of the power channel when changing control, disturbing and setting influences is established. A method for assessing power controllability based on a harmonic analysis of power signals in the energy channel of an electromechanical complex is developed. The coefficient of power controllability based on determining the power rms values in the system in various dynamic modes is proposed. A comparative analysis of experimental researches and mathematical modeling to assess the power controllability of an electrohydraulic complex during the development of nonlinear processes in the pipeline network is carried out.

articleTitle: Electric Strain Gauges Method in the Effectiveness Assessment for the C-Frame Crank Press Elastic Compensators
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The electric strain gauges method application to the elastic compensators effectiveness assessment for the "press-die" system of C-frame (gap-frame) presses is shown. The electric Wheatstone bridge was adapted, where the one arm is used on the equal mechanical stress calibration beam, and the other arm on the section of the press frame, which experiences maximum tensile stresses. The bridge arms' active and ballast purpose changed during calibration and research. After receiving the calibration characteristic between the current on the ammeter and mechanical stresses, the stress level in the press frame was estimated using various elastic compensators aimed at reducing them. It is shown that the use of elastic compensators based on polyurethane elastomers can reduce parasitic loads in the press frame by 15-42% compared to tensile stresses arising in the frame without a compensator. It has been established that the highest compensators efficiency is observed in the range of their upsetting up to 20-30%.

articleTitle: Multi-armature Electromechanical Converters of Impact-Force Action
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Using a mathematical model, which is implemented in the Somsol Multiphysics software package, the electromechanical characteristics of multi-armature electromechanical converters of impact-force action (ECIA) are obtained. Compared to the basic converter with one massive electrically conductive armature (MEA), the converter with MEA and coil armature (CA) increases the force amplitude by 1.46 times and the magnitude of the force impulse by 2.09 times. Using the efficiency criterion, which takes into account electrical, force and magnetic indicators, it is shown that an ECIA with two MEA and CA is 3-5 times more effective than the basic ECIA. Experimental studies of the ECIA were carried out while simultaneously measuring the current and temperature in the inductor winding, the impact force of the striker and the induction of the stray magnetic field. A model of a magnetic-pulse press for ceramic powders was tested on the basis of a converter with an MEA and a ferromagnetic armature (FA). It was found that impact pressing using a magnetic-pulse press, in comparison with static pressing, increases the density by 20%, reduces water absorption by 73% and increases the mechanical strength by 5.3 times of ceramic samples.

articleTitle: The Development of the Express Method for the Assessment of the Ecological Condition of Fresh Water by Physiological Indicators of a Biotest Object
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The methodological bases of a new express method of bioindication of the level of water pollution are developed using a representative of the Amphibia class as a biotest object. The choice of the minimum set of measuring equipment for experimental research of the test object, consisting of a three-coordinate accelerometer and thermal imager, is substantiated based on the determined requirements for the level of informativeness, sensitivity and accuracy of measurements. The test object sensitivity and rapid response to a number of typical pollutions and changes in water quality, usual for the region, is proved, which confirms the adequacy of the proposed approaches.

articleTitle: Modeling of Resonance Phenomena in Self-Oscillating System of Agricultural Machines
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Factors affecting the interaction of the active cultivator paw with the soil environment are considered in this article. It was established that the active oscillating effect of tillage machines on the environment leads to reduction in its traction characteristics, and the design of symmetrical movable paw is capable of self-oscillation in a horizontal plane. It was developed the theoretical model of oscillatory movements that takes into account the main structural parameters of working bodies represented by symmetrical cultivator paws of the active type. For laboratory studies, a circular soil channel is used, which ensures the movement of the soil relative to the stationary working body for an unlimited time, as well as recording the results using computer, photo and video equipment.

articleTitle: Technology strategy as a key factor of competitiveness of electrical and electronic engineering companies
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper investigates theoretical, methodological, and analytical aspects of the development of the companies’ technology strategy, which should be considered in the general set of strategies for company development. The basic approaches are taken as a basis for research of essence of technological strategy, particularly complex structural, process, effective, others, are generalized. The interrelationships of technological and other strategies of the enterprise are revealed. Methodical provisions on the research of features of technology strategy which approbation took place based on studying of experience of strategic management of technological development of the electronic engineering companies are offered. The influence of key factors in forming technology strategy, namely, capital investment, R&D expenditures, corporate culture, and others, has also been established. Several innovative mechanisms for the development of the company's personnel are proposed, the potential of which is the basis of technological development, and therefore should be reflected in the technology strategy.

articleTitle: Power Method of the Electrohydraulic Complex Parameter Identification Based on the Physical Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: It is shown that the operation of electro-hydraulic complexes is accompanied by a change in the main parameters and characteristics of pumping and pipeline equipment over time. The necessity of identification of the current parameters of the hydro-transportation complex in order to provide its energy-efficient operating modes is substantiated. The possibility of using the power method for identifying the parameters of electrohydraulic equipment in the formation of a harmonic test effect on the input of the system is confirmed. It is shown that the power method for identifying parameters should be based on the equations of energy balance between the power source and the elements of the power channel of the electrohydraulic complex. The adequacy of theoretical and experimental results as to the identification of hydraulic system parameters on the basis of a physical model of an electrohydraulic complex is proved.

articleTitle: Diagnosing the Insulation Condition of High-Voltage Oil Filled Bushings Using Likelihood Ratios
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: To diagnose the insulation condition of high-voltage oil-filled bushings according to the results of periodic tests, without using the maximum permissible values of insulation parameters, the maximum likelihood estimation is proposed. It is shown that the decision about bushing condition can be made based on analysis of ratio of indicator density functions in serviceable and defective bushings. In order to increase recognition reliability it is suggested to consider differences in insulation ageing rate of serviceable bushings caused by differences in their operational modes. The analysis of stochastic connection between the values of bushings insulation indicators has shown that the appearance of defects can lead to significant correlation between the indicators that are not correlated in serviceable bushings. A decisive rule has been formulated which makes it possible to carry out diagnostics of the bushings condition with regard to their service life. Practical examples of using the maximum likelihood estimation have shown its high reliability and ability to detect bushings defects at an early stage.

articleTitle: Space-Vector Control of a Three-Phase Shunt Active Power Filter Using the Rhombus Algorithm Current Tracking in Sliding Mode
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: A vector strategy for controlling a three-phase shunt active filter (SAPF), which is connected to the network with the existing nonlinear load, is proposed. The filter consists of a semiconductor voltage inverter with fully controlled switches, a capacitive storage and a single-link RL filter. The DC voltage stabilization of the capacitive storage using a second-order sliding mode, which is based on the implementation of a finite twisting algorithm is performed. A vector algorithm (the "rhombus-type") for tracking the instantaneous value of the current to generate a compensating current is used. The proposed algorithm uses the methods of projective geometry to determine the relative position of the space vectors of the voltages and the currents of the power supply system, so it does not contain difficult mathematical operations (for ex. - calculating inverse trigonometric functions). The choice of the appropriate output voltage vector of the SAPF inverter is based on the spatial location of the equivalent control vector, the coordinates of which are calculated in real time. The current tracking error sign is estimated using a quasi-stationary two-dimensional sliding surface, which is a linear combination of the components of the two-dimensional current error vector of the RL filter. A simulation model is developed and the results of simulation are analyzed. The proposed strategy is compared with the traditional hysteresis algorithm according to the criteria of the number of switchings and the coefficient of harmonic distortion in the current consumed from the network.

articleTitle: Corporate Brand: Essence, Evaluation Methodology, Experience of Electrical and Electronic Engineering Companies
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The article examines the theoretical, methodological, and practical issues of forming and developing the corporate brand and branding processes. The essential prerequisites for developing the corporate brand concept are noted, namely the intensification of competition, digitalization, technological dynamics. The vision of structural elements of branding is formed, among which the following are singled out: mission and strategy, strategic resources, corporate culture – as key. Justification of accordance with the concepts of “enterprise brand” and “product brand” is given. Based on the generalization of scientific approaches to brand evaluation, proposals for improving methodological provisions have been formed. A comprehensive study of key indicators of brand development of leading electrical and electronic companies identified the main trends and directions of increasing the level of monetization.

articleTitle: Impact of Energy Storage Systems on the Operation of Electricity Supply Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The main prospects for the application of energy storage systems in high-voltage power supply networks are examined. An analysis of the impact of energy storage systems on the distribution of power flows in the electricity supply network, on the stability margin of power system operation, and on the reliability values of high-voltage power supply networks has been carried out. A criterion for analysing the technical and economic efficiency of energy storage systems in electricity supply networks has been developed. This criterion allows the specific functioning of energy storage systems under electricity market conditions to be taken into account, as well as their impact on the modes of operation of electricity supply networks.

articleTitle: Analysis of electronic load advanced solution based on MOSFET-transistor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The introduction of electronic load for testing high-accurate low-voltage sources (solar cells) requires thorough reviewing not only the circuit construction, but also thermal and mechanical constructions. Adherence to the indications and principles, which are set out in this article, will provide the load with the ability to work at high power, and in the same time maintain improved characteristics and reliability.

articleTitle: Operational Planning and Analysis of the Transport Process in Terminal Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Insufficient efficiency of the use of automobile transport for intercity cargo transportation results in negative consequences for road transport enterprises and served companies. In order to eliminate them, the paper proposes key methods and recommendations aimed at identifying "bottlenecks" in the transport and forwarding activities of terminal systems as a key link in the entire transport process. It was found that the greatest unproductive downtime of vehicles is due to waiting for loading and unloading operations. A technique for analyzing the downtime of vehicles has been developed. It is recommended to use it when determining the tactics of operational planning and control in order to increase the efficiency of the logistics business.
